jobs.title: Software Engineer, Machine Learning - Ads Infra and Ranking
jobs.description:
Meta's Ads organization builds the systems that help businesses of every size reach the people most likely to care about what they offer. At our core, we're builders who care about shipping real value. Within Ads, the Infra and Ranking organization owns the technical foundation that makes this work at Meta's scale: the ranking models that decide which ad is right for each moment; the retrieval and serving platforms that evaluate enormous candidate sets in milliseconds; and the underlying data, training, and inference infrastructure. All of this is done while maximizing compute efficiency, ensuring reliability and privacy, and using AI to speed up development.As a Software Engineer, Machine Learning in Ads Infra and Ranking, you will lead complex engineering projects that improve how production ML systems match people with relevant ads.You will translate model-quality opportunities into reliable software and measurable improvements, working across model development, data, and serving to balance relevance with the constraints of large-scale production systems.

Software Engineer, Machine Learning - Ads Infra and Ranking Responsibilities:

Define and deliver ML engineering projects that improve ads ranking or retrieval, from problem framing and model evaluation through production rollout.
Develop models and supporting software, using data and analysis to diagnose quality issues and evaluate alternative approaches.
Partner with infrastructure and ML engineers on the data, feature, and serving dependencies needed to turn model improvements into production impact.
Design offline evaluations and online experiments that assess ad relevance, advertiser outcomes, and system performance.
Lead technical decisions and cross-functional execution for complex projects, making trade-offs explicit and building maintainable solutions.
Improve production quality through testing, code review, monitoring, and iteration across the model lifecycle.
Mentor engineers and help new team members ramp up in the relevant codebases and workflows, strengthening the team's ability to deliver high-quality work.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD
Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience developing and deploying ML models for advertising, ranking, retrieval, recommendation, or analogous large-scale prediction systems
Experience applying information retrieval and optimization methods to improve candidate relevance or ranking quality
Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn, including evaluation and integration into production software
Experience using offline analysis and online experimentation to evaluate model changes and understand quality, latency, or efficiency trade-offs
Experience leading engineering work across model development, data quality, and production serving dependencies
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into ML development, evaluation, or debugging workflows with measurable efficiency or quality gains
Experience applying responsible AI practices, including risk assessment, bias mitigation, and quality and accuracy reviews, to production model development
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development, including prompt/context engineering or agent orchestration, and evaluation of emerging technologies for engineering use
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. jobs.title: HPE Labs - AI/ML Engineer (Technical Lead)
jobs.description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Within HPE’s Office of the CTO and HPE Labs, the AI Enablement team builds on HPE’s established AI research, engineering, and market expertise to accelerate the transition of innovation into production by turning promising ideas into dependable, governed, reusable capabilities that HPE’s business units and customers can adopt and build on.

We sit at the seam between invention and impact. We don’t just prototype; we make AI real, repeatable, and trusted at enterprise scale. The team combines HPE’s deep technical expertise with a collaborative, high-standards, and intellectually honest culture focused on solving hard problems. If you want to shape how a world-class technology company operationalizes AI, this is the team.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a technical lead for the AI Enablement team. As a tech lead, you’ll independently drive high-impact “lighthouse” AI use cases from concept through production: owning the technical direction, partnering across functions and business units to deliver value, and establishing scalable architectures, patterns, and standards that make each subsequent use case faster and more effective.

This is a hands-on senior role for someone who's technically excellent and genuinely good with people: equally comfortable in an architecture deep-dive, a stakeholder negotiation, and a mentoring conversation. You'll have unusual scope to shape both the work and the team from day one.

“Hybrid – 2 days per week in offic
e

Key Responsibilities

Lead lighthouse use cases end-to-end. Independently own selected high-impact AI use cases from problem framing and solution design through production deployment and the transition to operational ownership, bringing LLM, agentic, and applied AI approaches to bear where they fit.
Build for production and measurable impact. Design the architecture of AI systems for scalability, performance, reliability, security, and supportability. Establish evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, documentation, and performance metrics that enable trusted adoption in real workflows and continuously improve the systems based on operational feedback.
Create reusable patterns. Turn each delivery into reference architectures, tooling, and repeatable patterns that lower the cost of the next use case, so the team scales through leverage, not headcount.
Partner across the organization. Work closely with stakeholders across business units, product, engineering, data, security, and HPE Labs to translate customer requirements, business needs, and industry trends into AI products, solutions, and systems improvements. Provide technical guidance, communicate tradeoffs and impact to technical and executive stakeholders, secure sponsorship and operational ownership, and drive adoption through credibility and influence.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship. Serve as a recognized technical authority for significant AI initiatives, guide architecture and design reviews across projects, promote consistency and engineering best practices, and coach less-experienced engineers through code review, design review, pairing, and example. Contribute to knowledge sharing across the organization and help cultivate a collaborative, high-standards team culture.
Help shape how we work. Contribute to the team's intake, prioritization, governance, and delivery practices as we build them, bringing judgment about what's worth doing and how to do it well.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience & technical skills:

Typically, 10+ years of relevant experience in applied AI/ML engineering, or software engineering, including hands-on delivery of AI/ML systems into production.
Demonstrated ability to take an AI/ML solution from concept to production independently, not just modeling, but the full lifecycle: data pipelines, deployment, evaluation, and operationalization.
Demonstrated experience shipping an LLM or agentic system that real users depend on, with ownership of its evaluation, reliability, and operation after launch.
Experience building and scaling enterprise agentic AI solutions across complex, production-grade environments.
Strong, current depth across AI and machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, natural language processing, large language models, generative AI, agentic systems, and statistical modeling, with practical experience in LLMOps or MLOps, evaluation, and production model lifecycle management.
Solid systems and software engineering fundamentals; comfort with cloud-native and/or hybrid deployment environments.
Working knowledge of responsible-AI and governance practices: evaluation, guardrails, security-by-design, data privacy, and how to build them in rather than bolt them on.
Bachelor's, Master’s or PhD in computer science, computer engineering, data science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Leadership & Collaboration

Proven ability to lead technical work and influence across teams without formal authority: earning adoption by being useful and credible, not by mandate.
Combines strong technical depth with a clear strategic vision, helping shape scalable designs, reusable patterns, and best practices.
Excellent stakeholder and communication skills: able to translate technical tradeoffs into business terms, align diverse groups, and build trust across functions and business units.
A track record of mentoring and developing less-experienced engineers; genuine interest in growing others.
Strong judgment and problem-solving: knowing which problems matter, when something is production-ready, and when to escalate or ask.

Who Thrives Here

Success in this role depends as much on how you work as on what you know. The people who thrive here and strengthen the culture we value tend to be:

Builders and finishers: energized by shipping real, dependable things, not just prototypes; they care about the unglamorous 80% (integration, evaluation, support) that makes AI work.
Intellectually honest: comfortable saying "I don't know," naming risks early, giving and receiving direct feedback, and challenging ideas respectfully. We're building a culture of psychological safety and high standards, and that starts with candor.
Collaborative by instinct: they bring people together across boundaries, assume good intent, and would rather make the whole team succeed than be the smartest person in the room.
Curious and humble: eager to learn, including from the researchers whose work they help transition and from the business partners whose problems they solve.
Growth-minded and generous: they treat setbacks as learning, lift the people around them, and want to help shape a team that's both excellent and a good place to work.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

About the Position

As an AI/ML Engineer
, you’ll design, develop, and deploy machine learning models that accelerate engineering simulations, improve accuracy, and unlock new possibilities in design exploration. From adaptive solvers and reduced-order modeling to generative design and real-time validation, your work will help push the boundaries of what computer-aided engineering (CAE) can achieve.
You’ll collaborate with experts in engineering and applied AI to integrate machine learning directly into high-fidelity simulation pipelines, helping customers iterate faster, identify and diagnose failures earlier, and bring better products to market.

Job Responsibilities
Research, design, and develop AI/ML algorithms to solve complex challenges in computer-aided engineering, simulation, and design automation.
Lead model and system performance improvements, including optimizing accuracy, analyzing outputs, and addressing system-level bottlenecks.
Stay current with advances in AI and simulation research, bringing emerging techniques in machine learning, generative design, and physics-informed modeling into production-ready solutions.
Build and optimize AI-powered solutions such as adaptive solvers, reduced-order models, generative design systems, and real-time validation tools.
Integrate machine learning models into high-fidelity engineering simulation pipelines.
Develop intelligent, data-driven models that enable faster failure detection, prediction, and diagnosis.
Contribute to the development of next-generation CAE capabilities powered by AI.
Help build foundational AI systems that transform how engineering simulations are designed, executed, and analyzed.

Requirements

This role requires 5+ years of experience developing and deploying AI/ML models in applied engineering or scientific domains
, along with 2+ years of technical leadership experience
taking projects from research and prototyping through production.

5+ years of experience developing and deploying AI/ML models, with a proven track record of delivering measurable impact in applied engineering or scientific domains.
2+ years of technical leadership experience guiding AI/ML projects from research to production.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.
Experience developing AI/ML solutions for sequential, spatial, or physics-informed data, including time series, text, meshes, or simulation outputs.
Familiarity with MLOps practices and experience building AI/ML systems end-to-end, from prototyping through scalable production deployment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with software engineers, CAE specialists, and applied scientists in a distributed, interdisciplinary environment.

Strong Plus
The following experience will be highly valued:

Experience with CAE, physics-based simulation, or engineering design tools.
Experience with NLP, LLMs, and agentic AI systems applied to technical or engineering domains.
Experience working in a fast-paced startup or research-driven environment.

jobs.description:
About The Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

Responsibilities

Lead the design and execution of LLM training and fine-tuning projects, including model selection, training strategy, experimentation, and evaluation.
Oversee the preparation of high-quality training datasets, including data collection, cleaning, deduplication, annotation, and quality validation.
Develop and optimize supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning workflows; apply preference optimization methods where appropriate.
Establish evaluation frameworks to assess factual accuracy, instruction following, domain relevance, safety, and performance on business-specific tasks.
Diagnose training issues and improve model quality, training stability, GPU utilization, and computational efficiency.
Manage and mentor data scientists, review technical work, and establish reproducible development practices.
Partner with product, engineering, and domain experts to define requirements and support model deployment and monitoring.
Manage project priorities, timelines, and compute resources, and communicate results and tradeoffs to stakeholders.

Required Technical Skills

LLM fundamentals: Strong understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, tokenization, language modeling objectives, and the differences between pretraining, continued pretraining, and fine-tuning.
Programming and frameworks: Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with practical experience using Hugging Face Transformers, Datasets, or equivalent tools.
Hands-on LLM training: Demonstrated ability to implement supervised fine-tuning (SFT), configure training objectives and loss masking, tune hyperparameters, and select model checkpoints.
Efficient fine-tuning: Practical experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), including LoRA or QLoRA, and an understanding of their quality, memory, and compute tradeoffs.
Training data engineering: Ability to build instruction-response datasets, apply chat templates, manage sequence lengths and packing, and prevent data leakage and evaluation contamination.
GPU and distributed training: Experience training models across multiple GPUs using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP or DeepSpeed, including mixed precision, gradient accumulation, and gradient checkpointing.
Evaluation and debugging: Ability to design reliable benchmarks and human evaluations, analyze model errors, and troubleshoot unstable loss, overfitting, and GPU memory issues.
Reproducibility: Experience with experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, checkpoint management, and documented training pipelines.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most product ive.

As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

About the Role: Building the Future in the Age of Agents

Join the elite technical and product engine of the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG). We are not a traditional project delivery organization; we are a practice of innovators and builders guiding our clients through the most significant shift in technology: the move to Agentic AI and Product-Led Operating Models. As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Agentic AI Delivery Senior Engineer, you are a new breed of technologist—a "product-minded engineer" who is as fluent in the language of code as you are in the language of customer outcomes. You don't just build solutions; you leverage the best of technologies Google Cloud has to offer for client requirements, helping clients break free from legacy solution mindset and practices to build truly modern, value-driven software products on Google Cloud.

You Are:

A passionate, hands-on GCP Senior Engineer who understands that great software is not just about elegant code, but about solving real problems leveraging the best technology tools available for a client. You are as comfortable building a multi-agent workflow on Vertex AI as you are testing a solution built by other team members in a compressed timeline, leveraging the various tools and technologies of Google Cloud. You have a consultative mindset and a deep curiosity to understand the "why" behind a client's business requirements and convert them to an optimal technology solution. You are an evangelist for modern ways of working, grounded in the principles of Product-Led engineering and operating models and related approaches. You are an exceptional communicator, great team player, continuous learner and a true believer in continual change.

The Work:

As a GCP Agentic AI Delivery Senior Engineer, you will be a technical and product-centric engineer in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud Agentic solutions for client requirements. You will partner with Accenture's global delivery teams by providing superior technical expertise and product innovation skills. Your role is to execute complex technology solutions for our clients by designing, building, and demonstrating Agentic AI solutions. You will act as a trusted team player, guiding others in the team on how to adopt a Product Engineering mindset and be the expert on specific Google Cloud technologies/products.

Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. Design, build, test and deploy innovative, agentic-first solutions on GCP that are directly tied to the client business requirements.

Hands-On Development & Proof-of-Value: Rapidly design, build, and present compelling proof-of-concept (POC) solutions that bring your Google Cloud proficiency to workable solutions. This includes hands-on software engineering using Vertex AI, Gemini/Agentic AI, BigQuery, Google Data technologies, Terraform, and modern CI/CD practices.

Product-Led Project delivery: Act as an agile SME/coach on modern software development. Guide and enable the delivery team on the principles of the Product Agile Operating Model and how to structure delivery sprints for continuous delivery using Google Cloud Technologies.

Team Collaboration: Ability to travel as needed for project meetings, workshops, client discussions, etc., Working with global teams and leveraging the various collaborative tools and channels for project delivery and status reporting.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

Here's What You Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).Minimum of 5 years of experience in a hands-on, client-facing technology role (e.g., Google Cloud Engineer, Product Engineer, Technology Consultant).

Minimum of 3 years of experience interacting with project team members distributed across the globe. Well versed in project management methodologies and product/project testing methodologies.

Bonus points if you have

Product & Agile Mindset: Hands-on experience working within a Product Operating Model. Practical experience in delivering agile projects, contributing to sprint based deliverables and outcomes.

Consulting & Innovation Acumen: Experience participating in client-facing innovation workshops and converting ideas into outcome-focused solutions. World-class communication skills to articulate project status and delivery challenges and issues to project leadership and client audiences.

Agentic AI & Software Product Engineering: Proven experience architecting and building agentic workflows using Vertex AI. Deep understanding of agentic components, including reasoning engines, planning, tool use, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Hands-on expertise with Google's Gemini models. A commitment to software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and building secure, scalable products.

Technical Depth: Multiple Google Cloud Professional certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Data Engineer, GenAI Leader). Project experience across the GCP ecosystem, including GKE, BigQuery, Vertex AI, CES, Apigee, and other GCP technologies.

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Management Level Definition:

Contributions include applying developed machine-learning subject matter expertise to solve common and sometimes complex technical problems, and recommending alternatives where necessary. An example is balancing answer quality, latency, cost, energy, and carbon in hybrid LLM systems. Might act as project lead for research prototypes and provide assistance to lower-level professionals and interns. Exercises independent judgment and consults with researchers, engineers, and platform partners to determine the best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives.

Responsibilities

Participates as a member of the Hewlett Packard Labs Machine Learning research team, carrying out the investigation, design, development, execution, and implementation of AI tokenomics research to generate new products, technologies, and intellectual property.
Researches and prototypes methods that learn representations of jobs and system states, and that predict workload complexity, answer quality, latency, token demand, energy, and cost.
Develops routing policies, model cascades, and adaptive controllers that select the appropriate LLM, reasoning mode, retrieval strategy, tool chain, and deployment target (local, edge, private cloud, or public cloud) for each job.
Develops methods to assign and enforce token, context, reasoning, and compute budgets based on job difficulty, priority, risk, service-level objectives, and expected business value.
Builds benchmark, telemetry, accounting, and workload-simulation environments.
Conducts controlled experiments, ablation studies, sensitivity analyses, and stress tests across model families, hardware platforms, and deployment environments. Evaluations measure answer quality, routing accuracy, token efficiency, tail latency, throughput, reliability, cost per completed job, energy per token, and carbon per completed job. Communicates results to team members for review and feedback.
Collaborates with internal and external researchers and engineers to validate results, and helps transfer promising technologies into HPE AI platforms.
Prepares papers and presentations for peer review, publication, and delivery at leading ML conferences and industry events. Creates patent disclosures and supporting documentation.

Education And Experience Required

PhD completed or expected soon in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, with a research focus in machine learning.
Typically 4 years of experience, including graduate and doctoral research.

Knowledge And Skills

Strong foundation in deep learning, optimization, probabilistic modeling, reinforcement learning, or related machine-learning methods, demonstrated through doctoral research, internships, or publications.
Ability to implement and evaluate research ideas in Python using frameworks such as PyTorch, with sound experimental and software-engineering practices.
Application of experimental design, benchmarking, ablation studies, and statistical analysis to collect, validate, and analyze research data.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to effectively communicate research plans, proposals, and results, and negotiate options at management levels.

Preferred Qualifications

Research experience with ML, LLMs, model routing, reinforcement learning, causal inference, constrained optimization, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic AI.
Interest or experience in token-efficient inference, per-job compute budgeting, multi-model serving, or edge-to-cloud AI systems.
Interest or experience in sustainable AI, energy-aware computing, or carbon-aware scheduling and optimization.

jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer | AI Security & Fraud Detection

Location:
San Francisco, CA - Onsite
Compensation:
$220,000–$300,000
Experience:
3+ Years, Ideally 5+ Years
Industry:
AI Infrastructure, Agentic AI, Cybersecurity, Fraud Prevention

About the Opportunity

Shields Group Search is partnering with a well-funded, early-stage AI infrastructure startup building the trust and security layer for the rapidly emerging AI agent economy.
As AI agents increasingly act autonomously on behalf of individuals and businesses, from booking services and accessing APIs to executing financial transactions, companies need infrastructure that can determine which agents are legitimate, who they represent, what actions they're authorized to perform, and whether their behavior presents a security or fraud risk.
Our client is building real-time verification and decisioning infrastructure that enables businesses to safely interact with AI agents at scale.
The platform combines agent identity verification, behavioral intelligence, risk assessment, and security controls to distinguish legitimate automated activity from suspicious or malicious behavior.

We're looking for an exceptional Machine Learning Engineer to build the models that distinguish a trusted AI agent from an attack, in real time and under load.

This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical founding-stage engineering team and take meaningful ownership of mission-critical ML infrastructure.
What You'll Be Working On
The models behind this platform operate directly on the production request path. They must evaluate activity and support trust decisions in real time, under the same strict latency constraints as the rest of the infrastructure.
There is no offline batch job to hide behind and no second chance if a prediction is too slow or incorrect.

You'll work on problems involving:

Real-Time Fraud & Threat Detection:
Develop ML models that identify potentially fraudulent, malicious, or unauthorized agent activity while minimizing false positives.
Behavioral & Anomaly Detection:
Identify suspicious patterns, anomalous agent interactions, and emerging risks across automated transactions and API activity.
Low-Latency ML Inference:
Build and optimize production model-serving systems capable of making accurate decisions under demanding latency and throughput requirements.
Cold-Start & Low-Label Learning:
Develop effective detection approaches when labeled examples are scarce, including unsupervised learning, weak supervision, and custom evaluation datasets.
End-to-End ML Ownership:
Build, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production ML systems, from data and feature pipelines through real-time serving.
Adversarial ML:
Help build systems that remain effective as malicious actors adapt their behavior to evade detection.
Agentic AI Infrastructure:
Work at the intersection of modern ML, AI agents, tool calling, identity verification, and security.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

3+ years of professional ML experience
, ideally 5+ years, building, evaluating, and deploying production models, not just research or notebooks.
Strong Python and a modern ML framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow); solid SQL.
Production ML systems end to end: feature pipelines, training, evaluation, and low-latency, real-time serving.
Comfort with low-label and cold-start problems, including anomaly detection, unsupervised methods, weak supervision, and building evaluation sets and labels from scratch.
Data analysis, statistics, and experiment design.
Strong software engineering. You ship versioned, testable, reproducible code, not throwaway models.
Experience working in highly technical engineering environments with strong software engineering standards.
Ability to take ownership, solve ambiguous problems, and ship production-grade solutions in a fast-moving startup environment.

Strongly Preferred

Applied ML in fraud, risk, abuse, account integrity, or security.
Experience building ML models for fraud prevention, threat detection, trust and safety, or other systems designed to prevent malicious activity.
Graph ML / GNNs, sequence or behavioral modeling, or anomaly detection.
LLM / NLP work, and familiarity with AI agents, including tool use, function calling, and MCP.
Experience in adversarial settings, where the threat evolves against the model.
Explainable, auditable, reproducible ML, with real model versioning.
Experience developing ML systems at highly technical, engineering-driven companies, particularly those working on large-scale infrastructure, payments, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or AI platforms.

Bonus Qualifications

Payment protocols (x402), agent identity (DID / VC), or crypto commitments (Merkle anchoring).
Experience at an early-stage startup or building ML infrastructure from the ground up.
Familiarity with real-time transaction monitoring, behavioral risk scoring, or identity verification systems.

Compensation & Work Arrangement

Base Salary:
$220,000–$300,000
Equity:
Competitive equity participation in an early-stage, venture-backed company.
Location:
San Francisco, CA.
Work Arrangement:
The team strongly prefers engineers working onsite five days per week. Hybrid flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates who can regularly collaborate in person.
Start Date:
The team is hiring immediately and can move quickly for the right individual.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Research Engineer, RL Environments
jobs.description:
About Us

Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better-aligned superintelligences.

Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives.

We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us.

Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude.

About The Role

We’re hiring experienced Machine Learning Engineers
to design and build reinforcement learning environments
to safely advance model capabilities in machine learning research and engineering. Specifically, you'll be teaching frontier models to do the work of an ML engineer or researcher at a frontier lab.

This role blends research and engineering
. It will require you to stay up to date with the latest research, develop novel approaches, and realize them in code. You will have full ownership and autonomy of the environments you build. Your work will include designing and implementing RL environments, conducting experiments and evaluations, delivering your work into production training runs, and collaborating with other researchers and engineers.

You will join our Capabilities org, a small, high-ownership team and contribute directly to the data layer that powers frontier LLM capability.

Note:
This role is only for experienced ML Engineers
. We have a separate opening for New Grads.

What You Will Do:

Design and build RL environments and reward functions that produce clean, learnable signals for frontier models on ML research and engineering tasks
Build deep expertise across the frontier of ML research, training, and inference infrastructure
Collaborate with others to brainstorm and create new ideas and tools to improve the environment building process

What We are Looking For (Qualifications):

5+ years of experience working in machine learning or research, primarily on LLMs and transformer models
You have strong ML fundamentals and broad research interests. You read many papers or tutorials, understand topics deeply and have the creativity to translate them into RLVR problems
Proficiency in Python and systems programming and at least one of PyTorch or JAX
Problem solvers who take ownership and drives solutions end-to-end
Passion for staying current with the rapidly evolving ML infrastructure landscape
Ability to meet throughput expectations and respond quickly to feedback

You may be a good fit if you also:

Have expert knowledge in an active DL/ML research area, with publications or public code to show for it. Research experience (PhD, MS) is a big plus
Have deep understanding of transformer internals, training/inference of modern LLMs, experience with inference libraries (vLLM, SGLang, etc)
Have strong expertise in kernel development (CUDA, Triton, Pallas)
Have built complex interactive RL environments

What we offer:

Competitive cash and equity compensation (>90th percentile)
Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment
Opportunity to work with top machine learning engineers
Health, vision, dental, benefits
401K match
Lunch provided everyday onsite
Weekly snack orders
Visa sponsorship & relocation support available

We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply.

Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude.

About The Role

Frontier research moves only as fast as its infrastructure permits. Building solid infrastructure is foundational to our mission of pushing self-directed learning as far as it can go.

We are looking for Senior
ML Infrastructure Engineers
to build the infrastructure and systems that power the frontier of post-training on large language models
. This role involves building scalable infrastructure to enable high-throughput systems and shape how our research is run, bringing us closer to models that can train themselves on what they aren't yet good at.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and scale the compute, scheduling, and data infrastructure that powers post-training research on our in-house RL environments
Develop and maintain core ML framework primitives and internal tooling that researchers rely on daily, accelerating reproducible experimentation and reducing time from idea to result
Build evaluation and benchmarking infrastructure, monitoring, logging, and debugging tooling, and automated testing and deployment systems, so failures are caught early and infrastructure stays reliable as it scales
Partner directly with Research Engineers to translate research needs into infrastructure requirements, and ship fast in response to their feedback

What We are Looking For

Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building production-grade LLM inference and training infrastructure (ideally from the ground up)
Experience building LLM training/inference internals such as transformers, distributed training, and working on inference libraries like vLLM, SGLang, Megatron

About the Role: Building the Future in the Age of Agents

Join the elite technical and product engine of the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG). We are not a traditional project delivery organization; we are a practice of innovators and builders guiding our clients through the most significant shift in technology: the move to Agentic AI and Product-Led Operating Models. As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Agentic AI Delivery Engineer, you are a new breed of technologist—a "product-minded engineer" who is as fluent in the language of code as you are in the language of customer outcomes. You don't just build solutions; you leverage the best of technologies Google Cloud has to offer for client requirements, helping clients break free from legacy solution mindset and practices to build truly modern, value-driven software products on Google Cloud.

You Are:

A passionate, hands-on GCP specialist/practitioner who understands that great software is not just about elegant code, but about solving real problems leveraging the best technology tools available for a client. You are as comfortable building a multi-agent workflow on Vertex AI as you are testing a solution built by other team members in a compressed timeline, leveraging the various tools and technologies of Google Cloud. You have a consultative mindset and a deep curiosity to understand the "why" behind a client's business requirements and convert them to an optimal technology solution. You are an evangelist for modern ways of working, grounded in the principles of Product-Led engineering and operating models and related approaches. You are an exceptional communicator, great team player, continuous learner and a true believer in continual change.

The Work:

As a GCP Agentic AI Delivery Engineer, you will be a technical and product-centric engineer in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud Agentic solutions for client requirements. You will partner with Accenture's global delivery teams by providing superior technical expertise and product innovation skills. Your role is to execute complex technology solutions for our clients by designing, building, and demonstrating Agentic AI solutions. Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. Product-Led Project delivery: Act as an agile SME/coach on modern software development. Guide and enable the delivery team on the principles of the Product Agile Operating Model and how to structure delivery sprints for continuous delivery using Google Cloud Technologies.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About The Opportunity

Building machine learning systems for risk at a global crypto exchange is fundamentally different from conventional ML engineering. The data spans on-chain activity, fiat deposits and withdrawals, trading behaviour, account access patterns, device intelligence, identity information, and customer interactions—signals that very few organizations can analyze together.

The problems are complex, adversarial, and constantly evolving. Models must identify emerging fraud patterns, scams, account takeovers, payment abuse, and other forms of financial risk while minimizing disruption to legitimate customers. Success is not measured only through offline model metrics. It is measured through prevented losses, improved approval rates, reduced false positives, faster investigations, and more reliable customer experience.

This role sits within a multidisciplinary risk team of machine learning engineers, data scientists, risk strategy specialists, analytics engineers, product managers, and operations teams. You will work across the full ML lifecycle — from problem formulation, feature engineering, and model development to real-time deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and continuous iteration.

You will also help shape how AI is used across the risk organization. LLM-assisted development, automated model workflows, AI-powered investigations, and intelligent review agents are part of the team’s daily work. We are looking for engineers who already use these tools effectively and can help establish safe, scalable, and production-ready AI practices.

What You’ll Be Doing

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build models and AI tools that help detect fraud and protect users at a global crypto exchange. You’ll apply deep learning and XGBoost, develop practical AI agents, and use AI coding tools in your daily work.

Build, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for fraud and risk detection.
Improve data quality, features, and model performance, balancing fraud detection with customer experience.
Develop AI agents to support investigations, summarize cases, retrieve evidence, and automate routine workflows.
Use AI coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging while reviewing and validating their output.
Work with engineering, product, and risk teams to deploy solutions and monitor their impact.

What We Look For In You

A strong foundation in machine learning, with hands-on experience in deep learning and tree-based models such as XGBoost or LightGBM.
Strong Python skills and experience training, evaluating, and deploying models.
Some practical experience building AI agents or LLM applications, including tool calling, retrieval, or workflow automation. Prototypes and personal projects are welcome.
Regular use of AI coding tools, with the ability to understand, test, and improve generated code.
Familiarity with databases and data pipelines for preparing training data and supporting ML workflows.
Good problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Nice to Haves

Experience in account takeover (ATO), scam detection, or other fraud and risk use cases.
Experience with LLM training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and alignment.
Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms and their practical implementation.
Experience with real-time ML systems, imbalanced datasets, or model explainability.
Prior fraud or risk experience is helpful
Fluency in Mandarin

Job Description

Stanford Law School Salary Budgeted Range: $117,536 - $165,000

Job Description

Research Engineer, Agentic Infrastructure

Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab), Stanford Law School

Stanford Law School’s Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab) is seeking a Research Engineer to design and implement the software systems that make the lab’s research possible. Working at the intersection of software engineering, computational research, and agentic AI, the engineer will build infrastructure for coordinating research agents, rapidly provisioning research environments, and running large-scale empirical experiments.

The Research Engineer reports to the lab Directors, Prof. Julian Nyarko and Dr. Megan Ma. The Directors collaboratively design the research agenda, study designs, and methodological requirements. The engineer develops the technical response to that design: assessing feasibility, contributing architectural and implementation ideas, translating research specifications into working systems, and iterating with the scientist as findings and requirements evolve.

The successful candidate will combine strong programming and systems architecture skills with an understanding of research methods and reproducibility. They will build modular, configurable infrastructure that allows researchers to vary models, datasets, agent strategies, and experimental conditions without rebuilding workflows from scratch. Their responsibilities will span the software development lifecycle, from technical design and prototyping through testing, deployment, maintenance, and performance optimization. Developing classifiers and baseline models will be part of a broader responsibility to turn collaboratively developed research ideas into reliable, adaptable computational capabilities.

Your Duties Will Include

Research Collaboration and Technical Design: Translate research designed with the Directors and other research scientists into technical specifications, implementation plans, and deliverable milestones. Assess feasibility, identify computational constraints, explain technical tradeoffs, and contribute design feedback that informs continued research development.
Agentic Infrastructure and Software Development: Design and implement modular systems for deploying and coordinating research agents, integrating models and tools, managing data, and executing experiments. Develop reusable interfaces and configuration-driven workflows that accommodate changes in research questions, methods, and experimental conditions.
Research Environments and Scalable Experimentation: Rapidly provision reproducible computing environments with appropriate software, dependencies, and data access. Build parallel or distributed experiment pipelines that support comparisons across datasets, models, prompts, and agent strategies, with appropriate logging, checkpointing, and recovery mechanisms.
Computational Methods and Validation: Implement classifiers, baseline models, analytical tools, and evaluation harnesses as research needs require. Read research papers and associated source code, test implementations against reference results, and collaborate with the research scientists and fellows to investigate discrepancies and validate computational behavior.
Software Quality and Reproducibility: Lead code review, automated testing, debugging, change control, and technical documentation. Establish practices for tracking code, data, model, configuration, and environment versions so that experiments can be reproduced and results traced to their computational inputs.
Operations and Performance: Maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade research applications and infrastructure. Diagnose complex failures, evaluate libraries and platform changes, and optimize runtime, data access, scheduling, and resource use while preserving experimental conditions and reproducibility.
Technical Leadership and Collaboration: Lead engineering delivery, exercising independent technical judgment within agreed research requirements and priorities. Mentor research staff as needed; develop clear implementation guides; and collaborate with computing and data professionals on development standards, deployment practices, and infrastructure planning.

Preferred Education

A Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, strongly preferred. PhD in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, would be ideal.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong programming skills in Python and the ability to select, adapt, and quickly learn appropriate scientific programming tools and libraries.
Demonstrated ability to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain complex software systems.
Strong understanding of modular software architecture, API integrations, data architecture, and data modeling.
Ability to rapidly configure reproducible research environments and resolve complex software dependency and installation issues.
Experience with scalable data processing, parallel or distributed execution, and performance optimization.
Working knowledge of research design, statistics, and machine learning sufficient to implement and test computational methods in collaboration with researchers.
Strong code review, debugging, quality control, and documentation skills, with attention to computational accuracy and reproducibility.
Ability to translate evolving research specifications into reusable technical capabilities and communicate feasibility constraints and design tradeoffs clearly.
Ability to plan engineering work, deliver against agreed milestones, and collaborate effectively with researchers and technical colleagues.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing, implementing, or evaluating LLM-based or agentic AI systems, including tool integrations, workflow orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
Experience building reusable infrastructure for large-scale empirical experiments, including configurable pipelines, containerized environments, and reliable execution across computing platforms.
Experience with advanced statistical or machine learning methods, or demonstrated ability to learn and implement such methods quickly.
Experience reading research papers and associated code to support replication, computational validation, and evaluation.
Experience with R or other scientific programming languages in addition to Python.

Experience mentoring developers or research staff and establishing shared practices for software quality, documentation, and reproducible research

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Conceptualize design, implement, and develop solutions for complex systems/programs.
Work with a variety of users to gain information, and develop intra-system tradeoffs between different users, as necessary; interact with a diverse client base and outside vendor contacts.
Document system builds and application configurations; maintain and update documentation as needed.

Compare, evaluate, and implement new features and technologies, and integrate them into the computing environment.
Follow team software development methodology.

The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. Product-market fit:

About This Opportunity

Every plaintiff firm's next case starts with a phone call. At Eve, more and more of those calls are answered by our AI voice agent, which qualifies potential clients and creates leads with no human in the loop. It is the only part of Eve that talks directly to a firm's future clients. When it's set up well, firms catch every lead. When it isn't, callers hang up and sign somewhere else. As an Intake AI Architect, you're the person who gets firms there. You own intake setup end to end, and the voice agent becomes your deepest specialty: barge-in and turn-taking, staying on script across long multi-branch flows, tool calls that don't leave the caller in dead air, and callers who go off script entirely. You won't do it alone: you'll work hand in hand with Eve's dedicated Intake product and engineering team and can lean on them heavily. This is both a build role and a product one. You'll see every intake setup at Eve, which makes you the strongest voice on what's hard and what the platform should do next. It's a new role. Map how leads actually reach the firm, then take it to "onboarding complete": the voice agent, phone system, lead sources, lead management and document systems, and scoring. Make the voice agent fit. Translate what the firm asks for into what it actually needs, configure the agent, take it live, and iterate on real calls until the firm is happy.

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

About You

You're a researcher who thinks like an engineer, or an engineer who thinks like a researcher. You've worked on information retrieval systems, embedding models, or neural ranking at scale, or you're deeply curious about the fundamental problems that emerge when training models to understand and serve billions of web documents. This is information retrieval reimagined for the LLM era, work that combines classical IR techniques with modern deep learning, applied at a scale that demands new solutions.

About Us

Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better-aligned superintelligences.

Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives.

We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us.

Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude.

About The Role

Models of the future will be able to train themselves on tasks that they are not good at. We are interested in investigating how far we can push the boundaries of self-directed learning. We are looking for machine learning
Research Engineers or Research Scientists
to push the frontier of post-training on large language models in a role that blends research and engineering, requiring you to implement novel approaches and shape research directions.

What You Will Do:

Train and evaluate models on our proprietary RL environments to validate data quality, surface gaps in task coverage, and close the feedback loop between environment design and model capability.
Architect and optimize our RL training infrastructure, from training abstractions to distributed experiment management, using frameworks like Verl, OpenRLHF, or similar. Help scale our systems to handle increasingly complex research workflows.
Design, implement, and test training environments, evaluations, and methodologies for RL agents.

Industry experience running end-to-end LLM post-training pipelines of models sizes at least 7B in size

Experience with at least one modern RL training framework

Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better-aligned superintelligences.

Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. About The Role

An RL environment is only useful once it runs reliably inside a lab's training stack. Every environment we build has to be packaged, sandboxed, run at scale, checked against each lab's requirements, and delivered in the format that lab's platform expects. Much of that work is still manual today, and it takes time away from the people designing environments.

As an MTS on our ML Platform team
, you will own the systems that take an environment from a builder's repo to a lab's training run. That includes Karotte, our open-source framework for defining RL environments, the internal platform that builds, runs, and reviews environments on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and the integrations that deliver them to each lab we work with. This is a senior ML platform engineering role
where you will ensure what our Capabilities team builds runs and ships cleanly.

You'll join a small Platform team and work directly with environment builders and post-training researchers. In your first six months, success looks like a delivery path to each partner lab that is mostly automated: tasks marked ready get built, validated against that lab's requirements, and packaged without hand work. Our needs change quickly, so you'll also pick up other platform and infrastructure work as priorities shift.

What You Will Do

Own the integrations that deliver our environments to partner labs: build container images, match each lab's submission format, and automate the checks that confirm requirements are met before anything ships. Do the delivery work by hand where you have to, then automate it.
Build and maintain Karotte, our open-source environment framework, from API design through releases and migrations that keep existing environments working.
Run and scale the infrastructure that builds, runs, and grades environments, including containerized rollouts and grading across CPU, GPU, and TPU, VM-based sandboxing, and the resource limits and isolation that stop a model from gaming its own grader.
Build the internal tools environment builders use every day (CLI, docs, data catalog, access controls, and run monitoring) so they spend their time on environment design instead of infrastructure.
Partner with environment builders and post-training researchers to turn recurring pain points into platform features, and ship quickly in response to their feedback.

Kovari develops frontier technology to transform physical businesses. We partner with established operators to change how they run, and we build and operate businesses of our own through our subsidiaries.

The Role

You will own what happens when our robots meet a real business. You run deployments end to end: scoping a site, launching robots into live operations, earning the trust of the people who work alongside them, and turning a pilot into a portfolio-wide rollout.
This is not an account management role. You will be on the floor at 6am when a robot gets stuck, in the GM’s office making the case for expansion, and in the room with our engineers explaining what broke and why.
Travel is a must. Operators are deployed on site for months at a time, embedded with the businesses we serve.

What You’ll Do

Own customer deployments from site assessment through launch, daily operations, and expansion
Map workflows at each property and design how robots fit into them
Train frontline staff and managers, and build the playbooks that make deployments repeatable
Run day-to-day operations: monitor performance, triage issues, and coordinate fixes with engineering
Be the primary point of contact for operators, from line staff to owners and asset managers
Measure and report impact: labor hours saved, service quality, uptime, and ROI
Identify expansion opportunities and drive pilots into multi-property contracts
Turn field feedback into product priorities, and shape what we build next
Work across our own operating businesses as well as customer sites

What You Bring

Experience in operations, consulting, hospitality, or another role where you owned outcomes on the ground
Comfort with technology. You don’t need to write code, but you troubleshoot hardware, read logs, and learn systems fast
Credibility with operators: you can talk to a housekeeper and an owner in the same afternoon
Strong judgment under ambiguity, with no playbook and real stakes
A clear, structured communicator, both in writing and in the room
Willingness to travel extensively and live on site for many months at a stretch
Bonus: hotel, property management, logistics, or field engineering experience
Bias toward action: show up, figure it out, fix what breaks

Values

Pace of learning trumps everything.
Relentless refinement of our craft.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Compute Scheduling
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS), builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help design solutions that power some of the world's most advanced computing workloads.

The MARS Scheduling team decides how NVIDIA's AI research compute gets used. That fleet spans many of the largest GPU clusters in the world, across multiple clouds and partners, running everything from frontier-model pretraining to reinforcement learning and agentic workloads. We run Slurm and Kubernetes at large scale. Our scheduling is coordinated and topology-sensitive on rack-scale systems. We manage fair sharing and quotas for hundreds of research teams. We support preemption and reservations. Elastic jobs recover from failure without losing progress. You will own real parts of the scheduling stack, and the opportunity to ship code into our open-source and internal platform code, and see the result in GPU-hours returned to researchers within days. The researchers training NVIDIA's own models are your users, and they will tell you quickly what works.

What You'll Be Doing

Design and build scheduling for large GPU fleets on both Slurm and Kubernetes. That covers queueing, gang and topology-aware placement on rack-scale NVLink systems, preemption, reservations and backfill that reaches the end of very deep queues.
Build the policy layer: fair share, quotas and allocations across many research teams, driven from a central allocation system and enforced the same way on every scheduler.
Run Slurm as a cloud-native service on Kubernetes, and extend Kubernetes batch scheduling (Kueue and its ecosystem) for training, reinforcement learning, sandboxes and inference.
Build services around the scheduler: reservation automation, node-health-aware placement, workflow orchestration across clusters, and APIs that let other platforms submit and track work.
Measure and raise goodput: GPU occupancy, waste, fairness and time to start for large jobs. Use the data to choose what to build next.
Own reliability for the components you build: on-call, incident analysis and fixes that remove whole classes of failure, so problems are found before researchers hit them.
Work upstream and across teams: contribute to Slurm, Kubernetes and related open-source projects, and partner with platform, storage, networking and research teams.

What We Need To See

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
6+ years building production systems software.
Deep experience with at least one batch or cluster scheduler, such as Slurm, Kueue, Volcano, KAI, YuniKorn or a scheduler you built. You should be able to explain its internals, not only its configuration.
Strong programming in Go, C or C++, plus Python for tooling and analysis.
Hands-on Kubernetes experience: controllers or operators, CRDs, scheduling and resource management.
Solid Linux systems knowledge: containers (Docker, Podman, Enroot or Apptainer), cgroups, networking basics and debugging under load.
A track record of owning a service in production and making it measurably better.
Clear written and spoken communication with engineers and researchers.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience scheduling large-scale AI training: thousands of GPUs, NVLink and InfiniBand or RoCE topology, multi-node jobs that must start together.
Contributions to Slurm, Kubernetes SIG Scheduling, Kueue, Volcano, KAI or similar open-source schedulers.
Experience running Slurm on Kubernetes (Slinky or similar), or building Kubernetes operators for batch or HPC workloads.
Familiarity with RL, agentic or inference workloads and what they need from a scheduler: heterogeneous jobs, sandboxes, elastic scale and fast restarts.
Experience with workflow orchestrators such as Flyte, Airflow, Ray or Kubeflow at scale.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 14, 2026.

The Senior AI Solutions Engineer (Engineer Senior)
will build and scale intelligent systems that improve healthcare outcomes. You will design, build, and deploy machine learning and LLM-based systems, taking models from experimentation to production within assigned client group, business unit or corporate department and utilizing various customer technology platforms. Also responsible for delivery of end-to-end application, system development and maintenance on complex multi technology platforms within assigned client group, business unit or corporate department and utilizing various customer technology platforms.

How You Will Make An Impact

Maintains active relationships with product, data, engineering, architecture, and business teams to translate business problems into scalable AI/ML solutions.
Applies AI/ML capabilities and modern AI tools to solve meaningful business problems, improve healthcare outcomes, and enable practical adoption across business workflows, digital products, and enterprise applications.
Owns the change request process and may coordinate with other teams as necessary.
Provides technical advice and weighs in on technical decisions that impact cross-functional teams, including AI/ML and advanced analytics solutions.
Researches and proposes new technologies, keeping abreast of developments in AI and applying them to enterprise use cases where relevant.
Designs, builds, and deploys end-to-end ML and LLM-based systems (data pipelines, models, prompts, APIs, and monitoring).
Develops, evaluates, deploys, and monitors machine learning models for predictive, classification, optimization, personalization, and decision-support use cases.
Builds applied AI solutions such as semantic search, RAG pipelines, and embedding-based systems.
Develops production-ready AI/ML services, APIs, pipelines, and reusable components; improves performance, scalability, reliability, usability, and operational readiness in production.
Performs technical design reviews and code reviews; provides technical leadership through solution design, best practices, troubleshooting, and mentoring junior team members.
Assesses status and supports data information planning.
Coordinates on-call support and ensures effective monitoring of systems, including AI/ML model performance and reliability.
Mentors others and may lead multiple or small to medium-sized projects.
Influences engineering standards and technical direction.
Identifies and proposes strategies around technical problems affecting the team, communicates standards, and gains buy-in on solutions.

Minimum Requirements

Requires a BA/BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field of study and a minimum of 5 years related experience; experience working with multi-dimensional platforms, and business and technical applications also required; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

Preferred Skills, Capabilities And Experiences

Masters or PhD preferred.
Advanced Python skills for machine learning and data processing preferred.
Experience across the full ML lifecycle (development, deployment and monitoring) preferred.
Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, or modern NLP techniques using vector search technologies like OpenSearch preferred.
Experience building production AI systems (APIs, pipelines, microservices) preferred.
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for ML/LLM systems preferred.
Familiarity with responsible AI principles (fairness, explainability, privacy) preferred.
Experience with cloud-based ML platforms and scalable architectures (AWS Bedrock, or equivalent AI model cloud providers) preferred.
Healthcare domain experience, including familiarity with data privacy and regulatory requirements preferred.
Multi database and/or multi language preferred.
Experience mentoring others, leading multiple small projects and providing troubleshooting support preferred.

jobs.description:
As a Sr. AI/ML Engineer II,
you will design, build, deploy, and maintain production-ready AI and machine learning solutions, leveraging advanced ML techniques to support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities and drive mission-focused outcomes. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, ensuring secure and effective system integration, while translating complex findings into actionable insights for diverse audiences across the organization. We know that you can't have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Serve as a hands-on technical lead for an AI/ML engineering team, providing technical guidance, architectural direction, and AI implementation strategy.
Design, build, train, integrate, deploy, and maintain production-ready AI/ML models and applications in secure environments.
Apply machine learning techniques to support retrieval augmented generation
Present results to a diverse audience in presentation or report form
Support architectural leadership, technical support, and advisement services to ensure system technologies are integrated and meeting the appropriate security requirements
Communicate technical findings, architectural recommendations, and project progress to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Extensive experience leveraging open-source AI/ML models, with the ability to evaluate and justify the use of proprietary models when appropriate.
Strong hands-on experience designing, building, training, integrating, deploying, and maintaining AI/ML models and production applications.
Experience developing agentic AI systems, including AI agents, orchestration workflows, and automated data-processing capabilities.
Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following AI/ML areas: Generative AI/LLMs, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or neural networks.

Python, TensorFlow, SciKit-Learn, Anaconda, Numpy, R, Keras, and Postgres

Expert-level experience designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML solutions in classified AWS cloud environments at Impact Level 6 (IL6) or higher.
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to assess program and system performance, identify manual processes, and develop algorithms or automation solutions to improve efficiency.
Strong experience designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining containerized AI/ML applications.
Ability to work primarily onsite across designated DC Metro locations, including Tyson's Corner and Reston, VA, with occasional customer-site visit
