jobs.title: Research Scientist/ Engineer 4, Fisheries Genomics
jobs.description:
Job Description

The School of Aquatic and Fishery Sciences, SAFS, has an outstanding opportunity for a Research Scientist Engineer 4 to join their team. This is a permanent 1.0 FTE position.

Reporting to the Professor, the Research Scientist Engineer 4 will independently lead genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic research addressing questions in marine ecology, climate resilience, and fisheries management, with an immediate focus on Pacific cod (Gadus macrocephalus) stock composition in the Northern Bering Sea. This position offers the opportunity to apply advanced molecular approaches to economically important fish and shellfish species in Alaska and the Pacific Northwest, working in close partnership with NOAA Fisheries science centers, academic partners, nonprofit organizations, and the fishing industry to generate science that directly informs stock assessment and resource management.

This position is engaged in marine environmental genomics and molecular ecology: the application of genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic approaches to understand how marine fish and shellfish populations are structured, how they respond to changing ocean conditions such as warming and ocean acidification, and how that information can be used to improve fisheries management and aquaculture. The field integrates high-throughput DNA and RNA sequencing, population genetics, physiology, and bioinformatics to answer questions about stock structure, local adaptation, and resilience of commercially and ecologically important species. Within the Roberts Lab at the School of Aquatic and Fishery Sciences (SAFS), this work combines wet-laboratory molecular biology with large-scale computational analysis and open-science cyberinfrastructure. Research areas span fisheries genomics, shellfish aquaculture, epigenetics, disease ecology, and climate resilience, with a strong emphasis on reproducible analysis and on partnerships with federal, state, nonprofit, and industry collaborators.

Research Leadership and Execution (40%)

Independently identify research priorities and design, plan, and lead genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic studies of marine fish and invertebrates, including Pacific cod stock composition in the Northern Bering Sea.

Plan and conduct field sample collection (including aboard research or fishing vessels as needed) and laboratory work, including DNA/RNA extraction, sequencing library preparation, coordination with sequencing facilities, and quality control.

Develop, refine, and troubleshoot molecular and experimental methods; maintain detailed records and protocols.

Data Analysis and Bioinformatics (25%)

Lead bioinformatic and statistical analyses of high-throughput sequencing data, including population genomic, differential expression, and DNA methylation analyses.

Build and maintain reproducible analytical pipelines; manage, document, and archive datasets in accordance with open-science practices and sponsor data requirements.

Dissemination and Reporting (15%)

Lead and co-author peer-reviewed manuscripts; prepare progress and final reports for sponsors; present findings at scientific meetings and to resource managers and industry stakeholders.

Proposal Development, Project and Partner Management (10%)

Identify funding opportunities and lead or co-lead proposal development as Co-Investigator; manage project budgets, timelines, and deliverables; coordinate research activities with NOAA, academic, nonprofit, and industry partners.

Mentoring, Training, and Service (10%)

Train and mentor graduate students, technicians, and junior staff in molecular and computational methods; contribute to laboratory operations and safety; participate in professional service.

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Minimum Qualifications

Master’s degree in fisheries science, marine biology, genetics/genomics, molecular biology, bioinformatics, or related field and four years of research experience in molecular ecology, population genomics, or a closely related area, or equivalent relevant experience.

Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager

Additional Qualifications

Demonstrated experience independently designing and executing genomic, transcriptomic, or epigenomic studies of marine organisms.
Proficiency in bioinformatic analysis of high-throughput sequencing data in a command-line (Linux/high-performance computing) environment and statistical analysis in R or Python.
Record of first-author peer-reviewed publications and scientific presentations.

Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Have you ever seen the headline in the news “ Banks Pass Federal Reserve Stress Tests ” and wondered how Capital One determines how much savings (or “capital”) it needs? Or maybe how we analyze the potential impact of the next recession? At the heart of these questions are sophisticated econometric loss models that help us understand the ways in which the economy impacts our loan portfolios and guide strategic decision making at the highest levels of Capital One.

In the Consumer Credit Risk Management Models and Data Team, we blend cutting-edge quantitative methods, with a deep understanding of our business, data, and regulatory environment to build and deploy predictive models for losses, account volumes and outstanding balances. These models drive key strategic decisions for loss allowances, stress testing, and capital allocation as well as informing our earnings calls and recession preparedness.

If this sounds interesting to you, join us! As a Data Scientist on the deployment & platform side of the team, you’ll be at the forefront helping us to usher in the next wave of disruption by using the latest technology to deploy, optimize and modernize model pipelines and execution platforms that enable machine learning models to provide powerful insights about our portfolio and growth opportunities through new data sources. You will partner with best-in-class data scientists, analysts, and engineers to innovate solutions that directly impact the company’s bottom line in a meaningful way. You will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibilities, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analytics
A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration

Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
Experience working with AWS
At least 2 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R

At least 2 years’ experience with SQL

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

Join a global technology leader as an Enterprise AI & Collaboration Architect, where you will help shape the future of AI-powered productivity and collaboration across the enterprise.

In this highly visible technical individual contributor role, you will work at the forefront of Microsoft AI, Copilot, agentic AI, and enterprise collaboration technologies, partnering closely with engineering teams, business stakeholders, security organizations, and Microsoft to evaluate and deliver emerging capabilities.

You will translate evolving technologies into practical enterprise solutions, lead complex initiatives from concept through implementation, and help define how AI-enabled collaboration technologies are adopted securely and effectively across the organization. This is a diverse, fast-moving role where you will have significant autonomy and the opportunity to influence the future direction of enterprise AI and productivity.

The Person

You are a highly motivated, self-directed technical leader who thrives in an environment where technology is evolving quickly, and every day may bring a different challenge.

You combine deep technical knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem with a strong understanding of AI and emerging agentic technologies. You are comfortable evaluating new technologies, developing solutions where a predefined playbook may not exist, and independently driving projects through completion.

Exceptional communication and leadership skills are critical. You will engage with stakeholders ranging from engineering and IT teams to senior leadership and strategic technology partners. You can navigate differing priorities, manage conflict constructively, and translate highly technical concepts into clear business and technical recommendations.

Most importantly, you are a self-starter who takes ownership. You can receive a complex objective, determine the appropriate path forward, engage the right stakeholders, and deliver results without requiring extensive direction or day-to-day oversight.

Key Responsibilities

Architect AI-enabled collaboration and productivity solutions across Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Power Platform) and integrate them with existing enterprise applications.
Evaluate, test, and implement emerging Microsoft AI capabilities, including Copilot, Copilot Studio, and agentic AI.
Design and support agentic workflows and AI-enabled integrations across enterprise collaboration environments.
Partner with Microsoft and other strategic technology partners to evaluate upcoming capabilities and influence enterprise adoption.
Support secure, governed Microsoft environments used by engineering teams, balancing innovation, security, compliance, and usability.
Lead complex initiatives independently, from requirements and technical evaluation through implementation and adoption.
Identify opportunities to improve productivity through AI and automation.
Serve as a trusted partner to engineering, IT, security, and leadership across a global team, providing U.S. business-day coverage and communicating recommendations and risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Experience

Deep experience with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Power Platform) and how its components work together.
Strong knowledge of enterprise AI, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Agentic AI, plus awareness of the broader AI landscape (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
Experience architecting, testing, and deploying AI and collaboration solutions, including integrations with enterprise applications, in a large enterprise.
Strong understanding of security, governance, identity, and compliance for AI and collaboration platforms, including Purview, DLP, and sensitivity labels.
Experience in highly governed environments (e.g., Microsoft 365 Government Cloud) or with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and NIST is a plus.
Track record of leading complex technical projects with a high degree of autonomy and partnering with engineering to turn requirements into practical solutions.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills across global, multi-time-zone teams.
Microsoft certifications such as SC-400 are preferred but not required.

Academic Credentials

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field strongly preferred.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance.

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Position Type

Full time

Type Of Hire

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Job Description

About the role

Reporting to the Head of Architecture for Platform Engineering, the Principal Solution Architect plays a crucial role in designing and delivering enterprise platform capabilities. Platform Engineering is chartered to deliver the shared capabilities that product engineering teams use to deliver secure, reliable, performant, high-quality products to clients faster.

Platform Engineering’s portfolio spans AI Engineering, API & Event Management, Front End, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Developer Experience & Quality, and Customer Identity & Access Management.

This role’s primary focus is AI Engineering~ architecting how AI and agentic capabilities are built into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) so that engineering teams can deliver higher-quality software faster and more safely.

You will shape the patterns, platforms, and guardrails that move teams from individual AI assistance to governed, agent-driven workflows at enterprise scale. Like every architect on the team, you will also contribute across all platform domains and may lead initiatives in any of them, so broad, enterprise-level platform thinking and engineering excellence are as essential as AI depth.

What You Will Be Doing

You will make a significant impact on the company’s modernization and transformation journey by designing, documenting, and driving adoption of modern engineering patterns for next-generation platform capabilities and the ways product teams consume them. AI-first delivery is central to that journey.

Your focus spans the full SDLC, from AI-assisted planning, design, and coding, through automated code review, testing, and security remediation, to agent-supported release and operations, along with the governance, security, and measurement that allow the enterprise to trust and scale these capabilities.

You will draw on significant hands-on software engineering experience in product delivery to turn complex business needs into thoughtful, practical solutions.

You will bring cloud-native and AI-native patterns to our platforms, build roadmaps that clearly sequence the steps of our modernization journey, and apply enterprise architecture practices such as governance, ecosystem analysis, and vendor evaluation, while providing thought leadership on what is possible as we transform engineering culture at FIS.

Specifically, You Will Be Responsible For

Contributing platform thinking and subject matter expertise across all platform domains, applying modern engineering and architectural patterns to design systems (APIs, services, events, data, UI, and supporting capabilities) that enable engineering teams to deliver product capabilities rapidly
Creating and communicating best-practice target-state designs that use cloud-native patterns and are easy for engineering teams to consume, supported by clear artifacts such as business case and process context, context and sequence diagrams, and architecture decision records
Leading the architecture and roadmap for AI and agentic capabilities across the SDLC, including requirements and design assistance, AI-assisted coding, automated code review and test generation, vulnerability and dependency remediation, documentation, and release and operational support, with clearly defined human-in-the-loop checkpoints and accountability for AI-generated changes
Defining the shared foundations engineering teams use to adopt AI safely and at scale, including governed model access and routing, agent orchestration and tool integration through open standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval over internal code and engineering knowledge, agent identity and least-privilege permissions, guardrails and audit trails, and evaluation, observability, and cost management of AI usage
Partnering with leaders across the Platform Engineering organization to introduce, socialize, and champion modernization of front-end, middle-tier, and back-end technology stacks within an AI-first delivery model
Leading evaluations of new and existing vendors for fit with Platform Engineering’s strategy, technology approach, and integration patterns
Defining and driving adoption of integration patterns across internal systems, services, and capabilities so that quality data, events, and services are available for consumption regardless of channel
Partnering with platform owners, product partners, and other stakeholders on the intake and evaluation of platform capabilities and features, influencing design decisions and approaches before execution and delivery begin
Validating designs through hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations, and contributing to architecture reviews and governance across the team
Articulating the business value of the architectural roadmap, including fact-based “over the horizon” perspectives with options and trade-offs that align to the broader business and engineering strategy

What You Will Need

10+ years of solution architecture and senior software engineering experience, including significant hands-on product delivery, in a fast-paced, global software delivery organization that operates with ambiguity
Expert understanding of software and internet architecture, including modern front-end and back-end stacks, API management and identity and access management, cloud-native and on-premises infrastructure (containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code), networking and internet connectivity, and browser and mobile application delivery
Deep expertise designing and delivering AI-enabled engineering capabilities, including AI coding assistants and agents, LLM application patterns (retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration), context engineering, and evaluation of model and agent quality, with hands-on experience applying them to real software delivery workflows
Strong understanding of the risks AI introduces into the SDLC, such as sensitive data exposure, prompt injection, insecure or improperly licensed generated code, and over-privileged agents, and how to mitigate them through identity, policy, human oversight, and auditability
Demonstrated track record of delivering platform capabilities that power consumer-facing software products, especially API- and event-driven systems
Deep experience adopting and operating within a modern SDLC and engineering practice (AI-enabled development, DevSecOps, CI/CD, GitOps, and platform-as-a-product)
Thorough understanding of modern information security and data protection practices and how to apply them across technology stacks in regulated environments
Collaborative, low-ego approach focused on business outcomes, with the ability to motivate and energize others and influence without authority to achieve common goals
Exceptional communication skills and can navigate and influence at every level of the organization, tailoring the message to any audience to achieve the desired outcome

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services or other regulated industries, including model risk management, responsible AI practices, and emerging AI regulation, and how they shape architecture decisions
Experience measuring engineering productivity and the impact of AI adoption using frameworks such as DORA metrics, and leading the change management needed to drive adoption at scale
Experience applying AI to modernize legacy platforms and codebases, such as mainframe or large monolithic applications
Hands-on experience with multiple model providers, agent frameworks, and the AI services of major cloud providers, including trade-offs in model selection, hosting, and cost
Undergraduate degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or another technical field

Personal characteristics

Demonstrates sound judgment and flexibility, thinking comprehensively about issues and developing solutions that account for the broader context and strategy
Maintains a positive, adaptable approach to rapidly shifting priorities, topics, and environments
Takes initiative, translating strategy into action and driving delivery with a “roll up the sleeves” approach
Remains calm and structured under pressure, bringing clarity to high-stakes situations such as major incidents and critical decisions
Builds strong relationships and negotiates effectively with internal and external stakeholders, grounding decisions in data
Combines intellectual curiosity and a drive for excellence with a track record of success and a reputation as someone others enjoy working with
Brings strong attention to detail, a commitment to adopting and implementing best practices, and a bias toward continuous improvement
Embodies and delivers the firm’s values and culture towards colleagues, clients, and communities~

Win as one team

Lead with integrity

Be the change

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

EEOC Statement

FIS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation. All reasonable accommodation requests will be reviewed and evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

jobs.title: MarTech Multi-Solution Architect
jobs.description:
As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the connective tissue across our clients' marketing and advertising technology ecosystems, spanning customer data platforms, journey orchestration and decisioning, campaign and content platforms, and adjacent AdTech capabilities, all increasingly powered by AI and agentic technologies. You will move fluidly across platforms and vendors rather than anchoring to a single stack, advising clients on the art of the possible, designing composable, future-ready architectures, and leading implementation across MarTech, AdTech, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role suits a technologist who treats the pace of change in this space as the appealing part of the job: someone who stays current on emerging platforms and AI capabilities, pilots new tools ahead of the market, and brings that point of view to clients and internal teams alike.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 13, 2027

Work you'll do

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

Architecting end-to-end solutions across the marketing technology landscape (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform/AEP, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Target; Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce; and comparable platforms) to enable unified customer profiles, journey orchestration, and omnichannel personalization

Bridging MarTech and AdTech ecosystems by integrating CDPs with ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, identity resolution, and measurement/attribution platforms to enable addressable, privacy-safe advertising and cross-channel activation

Architecting and maintaining identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph solutions, including identity matching logic, resolution accuracy, and data collection strategies that feed a unified, enterprise-wide view of the customer

Embedding AI and agentic capabilities into client marketing and advertising ecosystems, including generative content and personalization, AI assistants/copilots, and next-best-action or agent orchestration, and continuously evaluating emerging tools as the landscape evolves

Advising clients on future-state architecture design, feasibility, level of effort, cost, and the art of the possible, across composable, API-first MarTech and AdTech stacks

Leading technical pre-sales and solutioning (hunter/farmer cycles), translating business and marketing goals into technical designs, estimates, and phased implementation roadmaps

Leading integration and solution delivery across multiple platforms, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during technical design and implementation

Building and leading high-performing, cross-functional, geographically distributed teams of architects, engineers, and analysts, and establishing reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks

Evaluating and recommending composable architecture approaches that enable clients to assemble modular, best-of-breed MarTech/AdTech capabilities rather than defaulting to a single monolithic platform

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Genuine curiosity and a pioneer's mindset: energized, not unsettled, by a marketing and advertising technology landscape that is constantly introducing new platforms, tools, and AI capabilities

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of hands-on experience across marketing technology and/or advertising technology platforms, including implementation experience with at least two major MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud/Data Cloud, mParticle, Segment, Tealium, or comparable)
7+ years of experience architecting Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions, including data modeling, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and activation
7+ years of experience with identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph technologies or platforms (e.g., Acxiom, LiveRamp, or similar), including identity matching logic and resolution accuracy
5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales or solution architecture engagements, including level-of-effort, cost estimation, and roadmap development
5+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting MarTech/AdTech workloads
2+ years of experience with AI/agentic capabilities embedded in MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., AI assistants/copilots, generative personalization, agent orchestration)
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience with composable architecture / MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) principles
Working knowledge of the AdTech ecosystem, including ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, programmatic buying, identity/addressability solutions, and measurement and attribution
Adobe Certified Expert/Professional and/or Salesforce certifications spanning CDP, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce
Experience integrating MarTech platforms with AdTech data, identity, or clean-room solutions (e.g., LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, Google Marketing Platform)
Experience collaborating with identity partners to evolve identity graph coverage and improve enterprise-wide customer data mapping and digital tracking accuracy
A demonstrated track record as an early adopter, piloting new platforms, tools, or AI capabilities ahead of broad market adoption and driving their adoption within teams or client organizations
Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
Programming or scripting experience in Python, SQL, or Java
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related technical field

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 - $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Application, Cloud & Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
About The Role

As a Solution Architect – Application Modernization, Cloud & Digital Transformation, you will make an impact by leading solution architecture for large, complex client pursuits and transformation opportunities. You will translate client business objectives, technology priorities, and challenges into differentiated, scalable, and commercially viable solutions across application services, modernization, cloud, and digital transformation. You will work collaboratively with sales, delivery, technology, practice, and commercial teams to develop compelling solutions that deliver measurable business and technology outcomes.

In This Role, You Will

Lead end-to-end solution architecture for large and complex pursuits, proactive proposals, and RFP/RFI responses across Application Maintenance, Application Development, Modernization, Cloud, and Digital Transformation programs.

Translate client business objectives, IT priorities, pain points, and requirements into compelling solution themes, win strategies, and differentiated solutions that are technically feasible and commercially viable.

Design scalable, secure, resilient, and future-ready solutions across AMS, ADM, application modernization, cloud transformation, DevSecOps, SRE, AIOps, technical debt management, and AI/GenAI-enabled engineering.

Define comprehensive solution and operating models covering architecture, delivery approach, transformation roadmap, governance, resource models, tooling, automation, transition, risks, assumptions, and dependencies.

Identify opportunities to drive productivity, quality, speed, and cost efficiency through automation, AI/GenAI, accelerators, platforms, reusable assets, and industry best practices.

Collaborate with sales, delivery, practice, technology, and commercial teams to ensure proposed solutions are executable, differentiated, aligned with client expectations, and supportive of commercial objectives.

Lead solution presentations and discussions with client and executive stakeholders, clearly articulating architecture decisions, business value, differentiators, transformation outcomes, risks, and trade-offs.

Adapt solution architecture and delivery approaches as client priorities, requirements, technology landscapes, and business needs evolve.

Work model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring three days a week in a client or Cognizant office. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

15+ years of experience in IT services, technology consulting, solution architecture, or related areas, including significant experience designing solutions for complex client business and technology requirements.

7+ years of experience leading solution architecture or solutioning activities for large, complex pursuits, proposals, RFPs/RFIs, and transformation opportunities.

Proven experience leading large, multi-service-line proposals and managing solution activities across sales, delivery, technology, practice, and commercial stakeholders.

Deep understanding of digital services and enterprise technology solutions, with experience across application maintenance and development, application modernization, cloud transformation, DevSecOps, SRE, AIOps, automation, technical debt management, and AI/GenAI-enabled engineering.

Demonstrated experience developing solution architectures, delivery and operating models, transformation roadmaps, governance models, transition approaches, and associated risks, assumptions, and dependencies.

Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technology solutions, business value, differentiators, risks, and trade-offs.

Experience incorporating AI/GenAI, automation, accelerators, reusable assets, and platforms into enterprise transformation solutions.

These will help you stand out

TOGAF, ITIL, Agile, Cloud, AI, or other relevant architecture and technology certifications.

Experience developing differentiated solutions that balance technology innovation, delivery feasibility, business value, and commercial objectives.

Experience in solutioning for Retail, consumer goods and Manufacturing domains.

Bachelors/Master’s degree in a technology-related discipline, MBA, or equivalent advanced education or professional experience.

Applications will be accepted till October 23rd, 2026.

Salary And Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $119,700 to $180,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect (Process and Intelligence Automation)
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

U.S. Bank is seeking an experienced Enterprise Technology Architect to define, lead, and evolve our enterprise-wide Technology architecture strategy. As a member of the Enterprise Architecture team, this role closely partners with the business and the other members of the technology organization to design modern, resilient, and secure technology ecosystems and platforms that align with business objectives. The ideal candidate will have a blend of strategic and technical thinking, solving the most complex enterprise technology problems with enterprise grade solutions.

Responsibilities

Define and evolve the enterprise technology architecture strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, technology roadmaps, and modernization initiatives.
Establish and drive enterprise architecture practices, standards, and reference architectures across federated architecture and engineering teams.
Leverage Enterprise Architecture platforms (e.g., LeanIX, Ardoq) to maintain architecture visibility, governance, and decision-making processes.
Design and govern enterprise-wide technology ecosystems, integration patterns, and platform strategies across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.

Designs, develops, and implements BI, analytics, and AI capabilities and data-driven solutions, and leads large technical initiatives to address complex business challenges. This role supports enterprise business intelligence, analytics, and reporting initiatives within the banking and financial services industry.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions, along with a solid understanding of cloud technologies, data architecture, and data engineering concepts. The candidate can implement AI on BI and feature store capabilities, understand end-to-end data flows across cloud-based data pipelines, and translate complex business requirements into meaningful analytical insights. Experience supporting banking technology organizations, particularly CIO or executive-level reporting functions, is highly preferred.

This position is office-based, onsite 5 days/week.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

Designs, builds, and deploys Power BI semantic models and reports that provide governed, performant, and reusable analytics for business users.
Demonstrate a strong understanding of Power BI architecture, data modeling, relationships, DAX, and report performance optimization.
Implements AI on BI capabilities, such as natural language querying, Co-Pilot integration, AI-assisted insights, and predictive analytics, within Power BI and related analytics platforms.
Builds and maintains feature stores to support consistent, reusable features for machine learning and analytics use cases.
Translate business requirements into interactive dashboards, meaningful visualizations, and actionable reporting solutions.
Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into business applications and workflows.
Enforces and adheres to AI and data governance standards aligned with organizational goals.
Mentors junior team members to build, develop, and deploy BI and AI solutions and promote a data-driven culture.
Leads large or complex technical initiatives that involve technically challenging requirements, involving delegation of work and review of work products of the lower-level technical professionals.
Work with Architecture team to understand cloud architecture, data pipelines, and enterprise data environments.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Software Engineering, or related field.
Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in AI and data.
Strong knowledge of AI models, data architectures, and analytics methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

QlikSense experience, development, and deployment.
Snowflake/AWS Cloud experience.
Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and data quality practices.
Exposure to AI/ML technologies or AI-enabled analytics solutions.
Master’s degree in a relevant technical discipline.
Experience in the financial services industry.
Familiarity with regulatory compliance and data governance frameworks.
Experience managing complex technical projects.
Rally/Jira experience in an Agile environment.
Gitlab DevOps experience for software development and deployment.

The annual base salary for this position is $130,000 - $158,000.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Generative AI - Risk Tech)
jobs.description:
Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Full-stack Software Engineers who are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge open source frameworks and emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One.

In Risk Tech, we provide the foundation for Capital One to thrive in an uncertain world. Our engaged, empowered, and intelligent people produce outstanding products, working toward the common goal of transforming risk management with technology. We build data-driven tools that use machine learning to prevent risks & automatically detect issues before they impact our customers, our business, or our communities.

In this role at Risk Tech, you will work with our GRC team and partners across the company to build and deploy proprietary solutions for Risk management that are powered by state-of-the-art AI technology. Our products, enhanced with the transformative power of AI, are central to our business and deliver tremendous customer value.

What You’ll Do:

Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company
Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal & external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community
Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment
Utilize programming languages like Java, Scala, Python, Go, Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, Open Source RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of AWS tools and services
Provide technical leadership and direction across Agile teams, setting standards for design, development, and operational excellence
Partner with architects to define service boundaries, integration patterns, and reusable frameworks
Proactively identify areas for improvement, implementing targeted refactoring and contributing to efforts that reduce technical debt and enhance system performance
Influence long-term technology strategy through evaluation of emerging tools and practices in a ‘you build it, you own it’ environment

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
At least 4 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply)
At least 2 years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
7+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C#, Scala
3+ years of experience with database and database management systems
3+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or cloud-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies
4+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks
3+ years of experience with front-end JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks
4+ years of experience creating synchronous and asynchronous APIs
3+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks
3+ years of experience using Git-based version-control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Bitbucket)
3+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments
Experience leveraging modern AI-based coding tools and IDE copilots
1+ year of experience mentoring engineers and driving professional development within technical teams
1+ year of experience leveraging observability to identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in distributed systems
Experience with interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion
Experience leading cross-functional engineering efforts or large-scale technical initiatives
Experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $197,300 - $225,100 for Full-stack Engineer 4

Richmond, VA: $179,400 - $204,700 for Full-stack Engineer 4

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

jobs.title: MarTech Multi-Solution Architect
jobs.description:
As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the connective tissue across our clients' marketing and advertising technology ecosystems, spanning customer data platforms, journey orchestration and decisioning, campaign and content platforms, and adjacent AdTech capabilities, all increasingly powered by AI and agentic technologies. You will move fluidly across platforms and vendors rather than anchoring to a single stack, advising clients on the art of the possible, designing composable, future-ready architectures, and leading implementation across MarTech, AdTech, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role suits a technologist who treats the pace of change in this space as the appealing part of the job: someone who stays current on emerging platforms and AI capabilities, pilots new tools ahead of the market, and brings that point of view to clients and internal teams alike.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 13, 2027

Work you'll do

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

Architecting end-to-end solutions across the marketing technology landscape (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform/AEP, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Target; Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce; and comparable platforms) to enable unified customer profiles, journey orchestration, and omnichannel personalization

Bridging MarTech and AdTech ecosystems by integrating CDPs with ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, identity resolution, and measurement/attribution platforms to enable addressable, privacy-safe advertising and cross-channel activation

Architecting and maintaining identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph solutions, including identity matching logic, resolution accuracy, and data collection strategies that feed a unified, enterprise-wide view of the customer

Embedding AI and agentic capabilities into client marketing and advertising ecosystems, including generative content and personalization, AI assistants/copilots, and next-best-action or agent orchestration, and continuously evaluating emerging tools as the landscape evolves

Advising clients on future-state architecture design, feasibility, level of effort, cost, and the art of the possible, across composable, API-first MarTech and AdTech stacks

Leading technical pre-sales and solutioning (hunter/farmer cycles), translating business and marketing goals into technical designs, estimates, and phased implementation roadmaps

Leading integration and solution delivery across multiple platforms, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during technical design and implementation

Building and leading high-performing, cross-functional, geographically distributed teams of architects, engineers, and analysts, and establishing reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks

Evaluating and recommending composable architecture approaches that enable clients to assemble modular, best-of-breed MarTech/AdTech capabilities rather than defaulting to a single monolithic platform

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Genuine curiosity and a pioneer's mindset: energized, not unsettled, by a marketing and advertising technology landscape that is constantly introducing new platforms, tools, and AI capabilities

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of hands-on experience across marketing technology and/or advertising technology platforms, including implementation experience with at least two major MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud/Data Cloud, mParticle, Segment, Tealium, or comparable)
7+ years of experience architecting Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions, including data modeling, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and activation
7+ years of experience with identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph technologies or platforms (e.g., Acxiom, LiveRamp, or similar), including identity matching logic and resolution accuracy
5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales or solution architecture engagements, including level-of-effort, cost estimation, and roadmap development
5+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting MarTech/AdTech workloads
2+ years of experience with AI/agentic capabilities embedded in MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., AI assistants/copilots, generative personalization, agent orchestration)
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience with composable architecture / MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) principles
Working knowledge of the AdTech ecosystem, including ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, programmatic buying, identity/addressability solutions, and measurement and attribution
Adobe Certified Expert/Professional and/or Salesforce certifications spanning CDP, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce
Experience integrating MarTech platforms with AdTech data, identity, or clean-room solutions (e.g., LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, Google Marketing Platform)
Experience collaborating with identity partners to evolve identity graph coverage and improve enterprise-wide customer data mapping and digital tracking accuracy
A demonstrated track record as an early adopter, piloting new platforms, tools, or AI capabilities ahead of broad market adoption and driving their adoption within teams or client organizations
Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
Programming or scripting experience in Python, SQL, or Java
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related technical field

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 - $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

All of this is done while maximizing compute efficiency, ensuring reliability and privacy, and using AI to speed up development.As a Software Engineer, Machine Learning in Ads Infra and Ranking, you will lead complex engineering projects that improve how production ML systems match people with relevant ads.You will translate model-quality opportunities into reliable software and measurable improvements, working across model development, data, and serving to balance relevance with the constraints of large-scale production systems.

Define and deliver ML engineering projects that improve ads ranking or retrieval, from problem framing and model evaluation through production rollout.
Develop models and supporting software, using data and analysis to diagnose quality issues and evaluate alternative approaches.
Partner with infrastructure and ML engineers on the data, feature, and serving dependencies needed to turn model improvements into production impact.
Design offline evaluations and online experiments that assess ad relevance, advertiser outcomes, and system performance.
Lead technical decisions and cross-functional execution for complex projects, making trade-offs explicit and building maintainable solutions.
Improve production quality through testing, code review, monitoring, and iteration across the model lifecycle.
Mentor engineers and help new team members ramp up in the relevant codebases and workflows, strengthening the team's ability to deliver high-quality work.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD
Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience developing and deploying ML models for advertising, ranking, retrieval, recommendation, or analogous large-scale prediction systems
Experience applying information retrieval and optimization methods to improve candidate relevance or ranking quality
Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn, including evaluation and integration into production software
Experience using offline analysis and online experimentation to evaluate model changes and understand quality, latency, or efficiency trade-offs
Experience leading engineering work across model development, data quality, and production serving dependencies
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into ML development, evaluation, or debugging workflows with measurable efficiency or quality gains
Experience applying responsible AI practices, including risk assessment, bias mitigation, and quality and accuracy reviews, to production model development
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development, including prompt/context engineering or agent orchestration, and evaluation of emerging technologies for engineering use
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

As a Senior Data Scientist on Walmart's Fraud & Risk team within the Data & AI organization, you will leverage machine learning, deep learning, anomaly detection, and large-scale data to build and deploy predictive models that detect fraud, prevent abuse, and protect millions of customer interactions. Working closely with Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders, you will develop scalable AI-driven solutions that deliver measurable impact across one of the world's largest commerce ecosystems.

Use ML/AI, deep learning and data mining techniques to develop robust models for anomaly detection such as bot detection.

Unique opportunities in research and US patent filings to address new fraud issues, develop new tools or automate processes.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Within HPE’s Office of the CTO and HPE Labs, the AI Enablement team builds on HPE’s established AI research, engineering, and market expertise to accelerate the transition of innovation into production by turning promising ideas into dependable, governed, reusable capabilities that HPE’s business units and customers can adopt and build on.

We sit at the seam between invention and impact. We don’t just prototype; we make AI real, repeatable, and trusted at enterprise scale. The team combines HPE’s deep technical expertise with a collaborative, high-standards, and intellectually honest culture focused on solving hard problems. If you want to shape how a world-class technology company operationalizes AI, this is the team.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a technical lead for the AI Enablement team. As a tech lead, you’ll independently drive high-impact “lighthouse” AI use cases from concept through production: owning the technical direction, partnering across functions and business units to deliver value, and establishing scalable architectures, patterns, and standards that make each subsequent use case faster and more effective.

This is a hands-on senior role for someone who's technically excellent and genuinely good with people: equally comfortable in an architecture deep-dive, a stakeholder negotiation, and a mentoring conversation. You'll have unusual scope to shape both the work and the team from day one.

e

Key Responsibilities

Lead lighthouse use cases end-to-end. Independently own selected high-impact AI use cases from problem framing and solution design through production deployment and the transition to operational ownership, bringing LLM, agentic, and applied AI approaches to bear where they fit.
Build for production and measurable impact. Design the architecture of AI systems for scalability, performance, reliability, security, and supportability. Establish evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, documentation, and performance metrics that enable trusted adoption in real workflows and continuously improve the systems based on operational feedback.
Create reusable patterns. Turn each delivery into reference architectures, tooling, and repeatable patterns that lower the cost of the next use case, so the team scales through leverage, not headcount.
Partner across the organization. Work closely with stakeholders across business units, product, engineering, data, security, and HPE Labs to translate customer requirements, business needs, and industry trends into AI products, solutions, and systems improvements. Provide technical guidance, communicate tradeoffs and impact to technical and executive stakeholders, secure sponsorship and operational ownership, and drive adoption through credibility and influence.

You’ll collaborate with experts in engineering and applied AI to integrate machine learning directly into high-fidelity simulation pipelines, helping customers iterate faster, identify and diagnose failures earlier, and bring better products to market.

Research, design, and develop AI/ML algorithms to solve complex challenges in computer-aided engineering, simulation, and design automation.

Integrate machine learning models into high-fidelity engineering simulation pipelines.

About The Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

Responsibilities

Lead the design and execution of LLM training and fine-tuning projects, including model selection, training strategy, experimentation, and evaluation.
Oversee the preparation of high-quality training datasets, including data collection, cleaning, deduplication, annotation, and quality validation.
Develop and optimize supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning workflows; apply preference optimization methods where appropriate.
Establish evaluation frameworks to assess factual accuracy, instruction following, domain relevance, safety, and performance on business-specific tasks.
Diagnose training issues and improve model quality, training stability, GPU utilization, and computational efficiency.
Manage and mentor data scientists, review technical work, and establish reproducible development practices.
Partner with product, engineering, and domain experts to define requirements and support model deployment and monitoring.
Manage project priorities, timelines, and compute resources, and communicate results and tradeoffs to stakeholders.

Required Technical Skills

LLM fundamentals: Strong understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, tokenization, language modeling objectives, and the differences between pretraining, continued pretraining, and fine-tuning.
Programming and frameworks: Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with practical experience using Hugging Face Transformers, Datasets, or equivalent tools.
Hands-on LLM training: Demonstrated ability to implement supervised fine-tuning (SFT), configure training objectives and loss masking, tune hyperparameters, and select model checkpoints.
Efficient fine-tuning: Practical experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), including LoRA or QLoRA, and an understanding of their quality, memory, and compute tradeoffs.
Training data engineering: Ability to build instruction-response datasets, apply chat templates, manage sequence lengths and packing, and prevent data leakage and evaluation contamination.
GPU and distributed training: Experience training models across multiple GPUs using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP or DeepSpeed, including mixed precision, gradient accumulation, and gradient checkpointing.
Evaluation and debugging: Ability to design reliable benchmarks and human evaluations, analyze model errors, and troubleshoot unstable loss, overfitting, and GPU memory issues.
Reproducibility: Experience with experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, checkpoint management, and documented training pipelines.

Join the elite technical and product engine of the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG). A passionate, hands-on GCP Senior Engineer who understands that great software is not just about elegant code, but about solving real problems leveraging the best technology tools available for a client. You are as comfortable building a multi-agent workflow on Vertex AI as you are testing a solution built by other team members in a compressed timeline, leveraging the various tools and technologies of Google Cloud. You have a consultative mindset and a deep curiosity to understand the "why" behind a client's business requirements and convert them to an optimal technology solution. You are an evangelist for modern ways of working, grounded in the principles of Product-Led engineering and operating models and related approaches. You are an exceptional communicator, great team player, continuous learner and a true believer in continual change.

As a GCP Agentic AI Delivery Senior Engineer, you will be a technical and product-centric engineer in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud Agentic solutions for client requirements. Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. Product-Led Project delivery: Act as an agile SME/coach on modern software development. Guide and enable the delivery team on the principles of the Product Agile Operating Model and how to structure delivery sprints for continuous delivery using Google Cloud Technologies.

Team Collaboration: Ability to travel as needed for project meetings, workshops, client discussions, etc., Working with global teams and leveraging the various collaborative tools and channels for project delivery and status reporting.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. A commitment to software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and building secure, scalable products.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Job Description

Management Level Definition:

Contributions include applying developed machine-learning subject matter expertise to solve common and sometimes complex technical problems, and recommending alternatives where necessary. An example is balancing answer quality, latency, cost, energy, and carbon in hybrid LLM systems. Might act as project lead for research prototypes and provide assistance to lower-level professionals and interns. Exercises independent judgment and consults with researchers, engineers, and platform partners to determine the best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives.

Responsibilities

Participates as a member of the Hewlett Packard Labs Machine Learning research team, carrying out the investigation, design, development, execution, and implementation of AI tokenomics research to generate new products, technologies, and intellectual property.
Researches and prototypes methods that learn representations of jobs and system states, and that predict workload complexity, answer quality, latency, token demand, energy, and cost.
Develops routing policies, model cascades, and adaptive controllers that select the appropriate LLM, reasoning mode, retrieval strategy, tool chain, and deployment target (local, edge, private cloud, or public cloud) for each job.
Develops methods to assign and enforce token, context, reasoning, and compute budgets based on job difficulty, priority, risk, service-level objectives, and expected business value.
Builds benchmark, telemetry, accounting, and workload-simulation environments.
Conducts controlled experiments, ablation studies, sensitivity analyses, and stress tests across model families, hardware platforms, and deployment environments. Evaluations measure answer quality, routing accuracy, token efficiency, tail latency, throughput, reliability, cost per completed job, energy per token, and carbon per completed job. Communicates results to team members for review and feedback.
Collaborates with internal and external researchers and engineers to validate results, and helps transfer promising technologies into HPE AI platforms.
Prepares papers and presentations for peer review, publication, and delivery at leading ML conferences and industry events. Creates patent disclosures and supporting documentation.

Education And Experience Required

PhD completed or expected soon in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, with a research focus in machine learning.
Typically 4 years of experience, including graduate and doctoral research.

Knowledge And Skills

Strong foundation in deep learning, optimization, probabilistic modeling, reinforcement learning, or related machine-learning methods, demonstrated through doctoral research, internships, or publications.
Ability to implement and evaluate research ideas in Python using frameworks such as PyTorch, with sound experimental and software-engineering practices.
Application of experimental design, benchmarking, ablation studies, and statistical analysis to collect, validate, and analyze research data.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to effectively communicate research plans, proposals, and results, and negotiate options at management levels.

Preferred Qualifications

Research experience with ML, LLMs, model routing, reinforcement learning, causal inference, constrained optimization, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic AI.
Interest or experience in token-efficient inference, per-job compute budgeting, multi-model serving, or edge-to-cloud AI systems.
