new_jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer | AI Security & Fraud Detection

Location:
San Francisco, CA - Onsite
Compensation:
$220,000–$300,000
Experience:
3+ Years, Ideally 5+ Years
Industry:
AI Infrastructure, Agentic AI, Cybersecurity, Fraud Prevention

About the Opportunity

Shields Group Search is partnering with a well-funded, early-stage AI infrastructure startup building the trust and security layer for the rapidly emerging AI agent economy.
As AI agents increasingly act autonomously on behalf of individuals and businesses, from booking services and accessing APIs to executing financial transactions, companies need infrastructure that can determine which agents are legitimate, who they represent, what actions they're authorized to perform, and whether their behavior presents a security or fraud risk.
Our client is building real-time verification and decisioning infrastructure that enables businesses to safely interact with AI agents at scale.
The platform combines agent identity verification, behavioral intelligence, risk assessment, and security controls to distinguish legitimate automated activity from suspicious or malicious behavior.

We're looking for an exceptional Machine Learning Engineer to build the models that distinguish a trusted AI agent from an attack, in real time and under load.

This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical founding-stage engineering team and take meaningful ownership of mission-critical ML infrastructure.
What You'll Be Working On
The models behind this platform operate directly on the production request path. They must evaluate activity and support trust decisions in real time, under the same strict latency constraints as the rest of the infrastructure.
There is no offline batch job to hide behind and no second chance if a prediction is too slow or incorrect.

You'll work on problems involving:

Real-Time Fraud & Threat Detection:
Develop ML models that identify potentially fraudulent, malicious, or unauthorized agent activity while minimizing false positives.
Behavioral & Anomaly Detection:
Identify suspicious patterns, anomalous agent interactions, and emerging risks across automated transactions and API activity.
Low-Latency ML Inference:
Build and optimize production model-serving systems capable of making accurate decisions under demanding latency and throughput requirements.
Cold-Start & Low-Label Learning:
Develop effective detection approaches when labeled examples are scarce, including unsupervised learning, weak supervision, and custom evaluation datasets.
End-to-End ML Ownership:
Build, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production ML systems, from data and feature pipelines through real-time serving.
Adversarial ML:
Help build systems that remain effective as malicious actors adapt their behavior to evade detection.
Agentic AI Infrastructure:
Work at the intersection of modern ML, AI agents, tool calling, identity verification, and security.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

3+ years of professional ML experience
, ideally 5+ years, building, evaluating, and deploying production models, not just research or notebooks.
Strong Python and a modern ML framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow); solid SQL.
Production ML systems end to end: feature pipelines, training, evaluation, and low-latency, real-time serving.
Comfort with low-label and cold-start problems, including anomaly detection, unsupervised methods, weak supervision, and building evaluation sets and labels from scratch.
Data analysis, statistics, and experiment design.
Strong software engineering. You ship versioned, testable, reproducible code, not throwaway models.
Experience working in highly technical engineering environments with strong software engineering standards.
Ability to take ownership, solve ambiguous problems, and ship production-grade solutions in a fast-moving startup environment.

Strongly Preferred

Applied ML in fraud, risk, abuse, account integrity, or security.
Experience building ML models for fraud prevention, threat detection, trust and safety, or other systems designed to prevent malicious activity.
Graph ML / GNNs, sequence or behavioral modeling, or anomaly detection.
LLM / NLP work, and familiarity with AI agents, including tool use, function calling, and MCP.
Experience in adversarial settings, where the threat evolves against the model.
Explainable, auditable, reproducible ML, with real model versioning.
Experience developing ML systems at highly technical, engineering-driven companies, particularly those working on large-scale infrastructure, payments, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or AI platforms.

Bonus Qualifications

Payment protocols (x402), agent identity (DID / VC), or crypto commitments (Merkle anchoring).
Experience at an early-stage startup or building ML infrastructure from the ground up.
Familiarity with real-time transaction monitoring, behavioral risk scoring, or identity verification systems.

Compensation & Work Arrangement

Base Salary:
$220,000–$300,000
Equity:
Competitive equity participation in an early-stage, venture-backed company.
Location:
San Francisco, CA.
Work Arrangement:
The team strongly prefers engineers working onsite five days per week. Hybrid flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates who can regularly collaborate in person.
Start Date:
The team is hiring immediately and can move quickly for the right individual.

About Us

Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better-aligned superintelligences.

Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives.

We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us.

Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude.

About The Role

We’re hiring experienced Machine Learning Engineers
to design and build reinforcement learning environments
to safely advance model capabilities in machine learning research and engineering. Specifically, you'll be teaching frontier models to do the work of an ML engineer or researcher at a frontier lab.

This role blends research and engineering
. It will require you to stay up to date with the latest research, develop novel approaches, and realize them in code. You will have full ownership and autonomy of the environments you build. Your work will include designing and implementing RL environments, conducting experiments and evaluations, delivering your work into production training runs, and collaborating with other researchers and engineers.

You will join our Capabilities org, a small, high-ownership team and contribute directly to the data layer that powers frontier LLM capability.

Note:
This role is only for experienced ML Engineers
. We have a separate opening for New Grads.

What You Will Do:

Design and build RL environments and reward functions that produce clean, learnable signals for frontier models on ML research and engineering tasks
Build deep expertise across the frontier of ML research, training, and inference infrastructure
Collaborate with others to brainstorm and create new ideas and tools to improve the environment building process

What We are Looking For (Qualifications):

5+ years of experience working in machine learning or research, primarily on LLMs and transformer models
You have strong ML fundamentals and broad research interests. You read many papers or tutorials, understand topics deeply and have the creativity to translate them into RLVR problems
Proficiency in Python and systems programming and at least one of PyTorch or JAX
Problem solvers who take ownership and drives solutions end-to-end
Passion for staying current with the rapidly evolving ML infrastructure landscape
Ability to meet throughput expectations and respond quickly to feedback

You may be a good fit if you also:

Have expert knowledge in an active DL/ML research area, with publications or public code to show for it. Research experience (PhD, MS) is a big plus
Have deep understanding of transformer internals, training/inference of modern LLMs, experience with inference libraries (vLLM, SGLang, etc)
Have strong expertise in kernel development (CUDA, Triton, Pallas)
Have built complex interactive RL environments

Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment
Opportunity to work with top machine learning engineers

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About The Opportunity

Building machine learning systems for risk at a global crypto exchange is fundamentally different from conventional ML engineering. The data spans on-chain activity, fiat deposits and withdrawals, trading behaviour, account access patterns, device intelligence, identity information, and customer interactions—signals that very few organizations can analyze together.

The problems are complex, adversarial, and constantly evolving. Models must identify emerging fraud patterns, scams, account takeovers, payment abuse, and other forms of financial risk while minimizing disruption to legitimate customers. Success is not measured only through offline model metrics. It is measured through prevented losses, improved approval rates, reduced false positives, faster investigations, and more reliable customer experience.

This role sits within a multidisciplinary risk team of machine learning engineers, data scientists, risk strategy specialists, analytics engineers, product managers, and operations teams. You will work across the full ML lifecycle — from problem formulation, feature engineering, and model development to real-time deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and continuous iteration.

You will also help shape how AI is used across the risk organization. LLM-assisted development, automated model workflows, AI-powered investigations, and intelligent review agents are part of the team’s daily work. We are looking for engineers who already use these tools effectively and can help establish safe, scalable, and production-ready AI practices.

What You’ll Be Doing

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build models and AI tools that help detect fraud and protect users at a global crypto exchange. You’ll apply deep learning and XGBoost, develop practical AI agents, and use AI coding tools in your daily work.

Job Description

Stanford Law School Salary Budgeted Range: $117,536 - $165,000

Job Description

Research Engineer, Agentic Infrastructure

Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab), Stanford Law School

Stanford Law School’s Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab) is seeking a Research Engineer to design and implement the software systems that make the lab’s research possible. Working at the intersection of software engineering, computational research, and agentic AI, the engineer will build infrastructure for coordinating research agents, rapidly provisioning research environments, and running large-scale empirical experiments.

The Research Engineer reports to the lab Directors, Prof. Julian Nyarko and Dr. Megan Ma. The Directors collaboratively design the research agenda, study designs, and methodological requirements. The engineer develops the technical response to that design: assessing feasibility, contributing architectural and implementation ideas, translating research specifications into working systems, and iterating with the scientist as findings and requirements evolve.

The successful candidate will combine strong programming and systems architecture skills with an understanding of research methods and reproducibility. They will build modular, configurable infrastructure that allows researchers to vary models, datasets, agent strategies, and experimental conditions without rebuilding workflows from scratch. Their responsibilities will span the software development lifecycle, from technical design and prototyping through testing, deployment, maintenance, and performance optimization. Developing classifiers and baseline models will be part of a broader responsibility to turn collaboratively developed research ideas into reliable, adaptable computational capabilities.

Your Duties Will Include

Research Collaboration and Technical Design: Translate research designed with the Directors and other research scientists into technical specifications, implementation plans, and deliverable milestones. Assess feasibility, identify computational constraints, explain technical tradeoffs, and contribute design feedback that informs continued research development.
Agentic Infrastructure and Software Development: Design and implement modular systems for deploying and coordinating research agents, integrating models and tools, managing data, and executing experiments. Develop reusable interfaces and configuration-driven workflows that accommodate changes in research questions, methods, and experimental conditions.
Research Environments and Scalable Experimentation: Rapidly provision reproducible computing environments with appropriate software, dependencies, and data access. Build parallel or distributed experiment pipelines that support comparisons across datasets, models, prompts, and agent strategies, with appropriate logging, checkpointing, and recovery mechanisms.
Computational Methods and Validation: Implement classifiers, baseline models, analytical tools, and evaluation harnesses as research needs require. Read research papers and associated source code, test implementations against reference results, and collaborate with the research scientists and fellows to investigate discrepancies and validate computational behavior.
Software Quality and Reproducibility: Lead code review, automated testing, debugging, change control, and technical documentation. Establish practices for tracking code, data, model, configuration, and environment versions so that experiments can be reproduced and results traced to their computational inputs.
Operations and Performance: Maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade research applications and infrastructure. Diagnose complex failures, evaluate libraries and platform changes, and optimize runtime, data access, scheduling, and resource use while preserving experimental conditions and reproducibility.
Technical Leadership and Collaboration: Lead engineering delivery, exercising independent technical judgment within agreed research requirements and priorities. Mentor research staff as needed; develop clear implementation guides; and collaborate with computing and data professionals on development standards, deployment practices, and infrastructure planning.

Preferred Education

A Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, strongly preferred. PhD in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, would be ideal.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong programming skills in Python and the ability to select, adapt, and quickly learn appropriate scientific programming tools and libraries.
Demonstrated ability to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain complex software systems.
Strong understanding of modular software architecture, API integrations, data architecture, and data modeling.
Ability to rapidly configure reproducible research environments and resolve complex software dependency and installation issues.
Experience with scalable data processing, parallel or distributed execution, and performance optimization.
Working knowledge of research design, statistics, and machine learning sufficient to implement and test computational methods in collaboration with researchers.
Strong code review, debugging, quality control, and documentation skills, with attention to computational accuracy and reproducibility.
Ability to translate evolving research specifications into reusable technical capabilities and communicate feasibility constraints and design tradeoffs clearly.
Ability to plan engineering work, deliver against agreed milestones, and collaborate effectively with researchers and technical colleagues.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing, implementing, or evaluating LLM-based or agentic AI systems, including tool integrations, workflow orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
Experience building reusable infrastructure for large-scale empirical experiments, including configurable pipelines, containerized environments, and reliable execution across computing platforms.
Experience with advanced statistical or machine learning methods, or demonstrated ability to learn and implement such methods quickly.
Experience reading research papers and associated code to support replication, computational validation, and evaluation.
Experience with R or other scientific programming languages in addition to Python.

Experience mentoring developers or research staff and establishing shared practices for software quality, documentation, and reproducible research

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Conceptualize design, implement, and develop solutions for complex systems/programs.
Work with a variety of users to gain information, and develop intra-system tradeoffs between different users, as necessary; interact with a diverse client base and outside vendor contacts.
Document system builds and application configurations; maintain and update documentation as needed.
Provide technical analysis, design, development, conversion, and implementation work.
Work as a project leader, as needed, for projects of moderate complexity.
Serve as a technical resource for applications.
Compare, evaluate, and implement new features and technologies, and integrate them into the computing environment.
Follow team software development methodology.
Mentor junior software developers.

Minimum Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree and five years of relevant experience, or a combination of education and relevant experience.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Expertise in designing, developing, testing, and deploying applications.
Proficiency with application design and data modeling.
Ability to define and solve logical problems for highly technical applications.
Effective communication skills with both technical and non-technical clients.
Ability to lead activities on structured team development projects.
Ability to select, adapt, and effectively use a variety of programming methods.
Knowledge of application domain.

new_jobs.description:
About Eve

Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit:
Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.

Backed by top investors:
We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.

Built by a world-class team:
Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.

AI-Native from day one:
We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.

Explosive growth:
We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

About This Opportunity

Every plaintiff firm's next case starts with a phone call. At Eve, more and more of those calls are answered by our AI voice agent, which qualifies potential clients and creates leads with no human in the loop. It is the only part of Eve that talks directly to a firm's future clients. When it's set up well, firms catch every lead. When it isn't, callers hang up and sign somewhere else. As an Intake AI Architect, you're the person who gets firms there. You own intake setup end to end, and the voice agent becomes your deepest specialty: barge-in and turn-taking, staying on script across long multi-branch flows, tool calls that don't leave the caller in dead air, and callers who go off script entirely. Today that knowledge lives in a few people's heads. We are hiring the person who owns it. You won't do it alone: you'll work hand in hand with Eve's dedicated Intake product and engineering team and can lean on them heavily. This is both a build role and a product one. You'll see every intake setup at Eve, which makes you the strongest voice on what's hard and what the platform should do next. It's a new role. You'll define as much as you execute, and shape how it grows.

Location and travel:
On-site in San Francisco or San Mateo preferred, open to remote. Expect regular travel to client sites. If you're remote, plan on about one week a month in the Bay Area with the Intake team.

What You'll Do

Own intake setup end to end. Map how leads actually reach the firm, then take it to "onboarding complete": the voice agent, phone system, lead sources, lead management and document systems, and scoring. The Customer Success Manager owns the account. You own whether the firm's intake works. Success is firms live and staying live, not configs shipped. No more firms disappearing mid-setup.
Make the voice agent fit. Translate what the firm asks for into what it actually needs, configure the agent, take it live, and iterate on real calls until the firm is happy.
Shape the product. Bring what you see across every firm back to product and engineering. You'll be the strongest voice on what gets built next for intake.
Make firm requests disappear. Handle change requests fast, then fix the root cause in the product or the default templates so the next firm never has to ask.
Help build how Eve evals voice agents. Turn the test calls and call reviews you'd run anyway into a repeatable process. With product and engineering, define what "the voice agent did the right thing" means for our hardest firms, and test it against model and platform upgrades, interruptions, off-script callers, and long flows.
Be the expert others learn from. Write the runbooks and training that let Customer Success and our Legal AI Architects, who build custom AI agents for firms, run 80% of intake setups without you, so your time goes to the hardest firms and the product.

Problems You'll Take On

A firm going live next week with a complicated transfer tree: take it from questionnaire to live calls and tune it until every transfer lands.
A voice agent that fumbles existing clients calling for case updates: rework the call flow and prove it on real calls.
Leads from a firm's referral partners that never reach Eve: trace the gap and close it.
The call reviews you'd run anyway: turn them into a repeatable test set that catches problems before the firm does.

What You'll Work With

Eve's voice agent platform: the prompts, configuration, and admin tooling that power every firm's voice agent
Call recordings, transcripts, and lead data for every firm you support
Eval tooling, including an internal Slack agent that builds and runs eval datasets, plus Braintrust
Each firm's own stack: phone systems, web forms and chat, lead management systems like Lead Docket, document management

What We Are Looking For

3+ years of experience in intake, legal operations, implementation, or building with AI.
You know intake from the inside. You've run or worked intake at a plaintiff firm or a similar high-volume, phone-first operation, or you've implemented intake systems for firms. You know the edge cases: the catastrophic-injury caller who needs a partner now, the existing client calling the intake line for a case update, the caller whose statute of limitations runs out next week, the conflict check before anyone promises anything.
You test AI, or want to. You've written evals, test-call scripts, or regression checklists for an AI system, or you're eager to learn how. You'd rather prove the voice agent works than assume it does.
You hear the real ask, then build it. An intake manager says "make the voice agent friendlier" and you figure out what they mean, explain the plan clearly, then configure it yourself.
You're fearless with systems. Phone trees, call forwarding, CRMs, webhooks, admin portals. You're the one who gets on a screen share with a firm's phone vendor and figures it out, then writes it down so the next firm never needs the call

Nice to Haves

Comfort with code. If you can contribute back to in-product tooling, build your own tools, or improve the voice agent platform itself, that's incredible
Experience with voice AI platforms (Retell, Vapi, LiveKit, Twilio) or contact center tooling
Hands-on experience with legal tech like Lead Docket, Litify, Filevine, or Clio
Prior forward deployed, solutions engineering, or implementation work

new_jobs.description:
About Us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

About You

You're a researcher who thinks like an engineer, or an engineer who thinks like a researcher. You've worked on information retrieval systems, embedding models, or neural ranking at scale, or you're deeply curious about the fundamental problems that emerge when training models to understand and serve billions of web documents. You thrive in the space between theory and production, where elegant solutions must also run efficiently on real infrastructure. You're comfortable reading papers from SIGIR and RecSys one day and debugging distributed training pipelines the next.

The role

You'll design and train the models that power Parallel's APIs: the intelligence layer that helps AI agents find exactly what they need from the open web. This means tackling research problems that most labs encounter only at hyperscale: How do you train embedding models that capture semantic intent across diverse query types? How do you balance model expressiveness with sub-second retrieval latency? How do you maintain index freshness when the web updates constantly, without rebuilding from scratch?

Unlike traditional search engines built for human queries, you're building for AI agents that issue complex, multi-hop queries and expect structured, programmatic responses. This is information retrieval reimagined for the LLM era, work that combines classical IR techniques with modern deep learning, applied at a scale that demands new solutions.

You might be a good fit if you have:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Years of experience required will correlated with the internal job level requirements for this position

Life at Parallel

Our team works fully in-person
, between our Palo Alto HQ and San Francisco office. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.

We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.
Obsess over craft: Perfect every detail because quality compounds.
Accelerate change: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.
Create win-wins: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better-aligned superintelligences.

Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives.

We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us.

Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude.

About The Role

Models of the future will be able to train themselves on tasks that they are not good at. We are interested in investigating how far we can push the boundaries of self-directed learning. We are looking for machine learning
Research Engineers or Research Scientists
to push the frontier of post-training on large language models in a role that blends research and engineering, requiring you to implement novel approaches and shape research directions.

What You Will Do:

Train and evaluate models on our proprietary RL environments to validate data quality, surface gaps in task coverage, and close the feedback loop between environment design and model capability.
Architect and optimize our RL training infrastructure, from training abstractions to distributed experiment management, using frameworks like Verl, OpenRLHF, or similar. Help scale our systems to handle increasingly complex research workflows.
Design, implement, and test training environments, evaluations, and methodologies for RL agents.
Profile and optimize training runs end-to-end, from data loading through reward computation, to maximize experiment throughput and shorten the research iteration cycle.

What We are Looking For

Industry experience running end-to-end LLM post-training pipelines of models sizes at least 7B in size

Experience with at least one modern RL training framework
Experience building and operating ML infrastructure at scale

Have experience evaluating model outputs and building reward or evaluation signals

Opportunity to work with top machine learning engineers

new_jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better-aligned superintelligences.

Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives.

We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us.

Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude.

About The Role

An RL environment is only useful once it runs reliably inside a lab's training stack. Every environment we build has to be packaged, sandboxed, run at scale, checked against each lab's requirements, and delivered in the format that lab's platform expects. Much of that work is still manual today, and it takes time away from the people designing environments.

As an MTS on our ML Platform team
, you will own the systems that take an environment from a builder's repo to a lab's training run. That includes Karotte, our open-source framework for defining RL environments, the internal platform that builds, runs, and reviews environments on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and the integrations that deliver them to each lab we work with. This is a senior ML platform engineering role
where you will ensure what our Capabilities team builds runs and ships cleanly.

You'll join a small Platform team and work directly with environment builders and post-training researchers. In your first six months, success looks like a delivery path to each partner lab that is mostly automated: tasks marked ready get built, validated against that lab's requirements, and packaged without hand work. Our needs change quickly, so you'll also pick up other platform and infrastructure work as priorities shift.

What You Will Do

Own the integrations that deliver our environments to partner labs: build container images, match each lab's submission format, and automate the checks that confirm requirements are met before anything ships. Do the delivery work by hand where you have to, then automate it.
Build and maintain Karotte, our open-source environment framework, from API design through releases and migrations that keep existing environments working.
Run and scale the infrastructure that builds, runs, and grades environments, including containerized rollouts and grading across CPU, GPU, and TPU, VM-based sandboxing, and the resource limits and isolation that stop a model from gaming its own grader.
Build the internal tools environment builders use every day (CLI, docs, data catalog, access controls, and run monitoring) so they spend their time on environment design instead of infrastructure.
Partner with environment builders and post-training researchers to turn recurring pain points into platform features, and ship quickly in response to their feedback.

What We are Looking For

5+ years of experience building and owning ML Platform Engineering, ideally AI related ML Platform Engineering
Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of building and operating production infrastructure or developer platforms that other engineers depend on.
Hands-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar) and at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or similar).
A working understanding of how to run untrusted code safely: isolation, resource limits, and what happens when a process fills the disk or refuses to exit.
You've owned something tedious end to end, such as a migration, a release process, or a delivery pipeline, and automated away as much of it as you could.
Extensive hands-on use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and an intuition for where models cut corners.
Proficiency in Python, including writing libraries and APIs that other people build on.

Nice to Have

Experience building RL environments, eval harnesses, or agent benchmarks (Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench, or similar).
Familiarity with RL post-training and inference stacks (verl, Ray, SkyPilot, vLLM, SGLang, or similar).

You've built sandbox or code-execution infrastructure (microVMs such as Firecracker, gVisor, or similar) at an infrastructure startup or frontier lab.
You've been an early platform or infrastructure engineer at a startup and built the internal platform the rest of engineering relied on.
You've worked as a forward deployed or integrations engineer, getting your company's software running inside customers' own environments.
You've built developer tooling or internal platforms used by ML researchers, even outside a formal ML role.
You've maintained an open-source developer framework with real external users.

Opportunity to work alongside senior and staff engineers from frontier labs and infrastructure companies, plus top ML engineers
Health, vision, dental, benefits
401K match

Kovari develops frontier technology to transform physical businesses. We partner with established operators to change how they run, and we build and operate businesses of our own through our subsidiaries.
We are a small team of builders, operators, and researchers. We deploy on site, alongside the businesses we serve, and iterate in the field. We have raised over $6M from leading investors.

The Role

You will own what happens when our robots meet a real business. You run deployments end to end: scoping a site, launching robots into live operations, earning the trust of the people who work alongside them, and turning a pilot into a portfolio-wide rollout.
This is not an account management role. You will be on the floor at 6am when a robot gets stuck, in the GM’s office making the case for expansion, and in the room with our engineers explaining what broke and why.

Eve's revenue teams run on our CRM, and they need an expert they can count on. new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Compute Scheduling
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS), builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help design solutions that power some of the world's most advanced computing workloads.

The MARS Scheduling team decides how NVIDIA's AI research compute gets used. That fleet spans many of the largest GPU clusters in the world, across multiple clouds and partners, running everything from frontier-model pretraining to reinforcement learning and agentic workloads. We run Slurm and Kubernetes at large scale. Our scheduling is coordinated and topology-sensitive on rack-scale systems. We manage fair sharing and quotas for hundreds of research teams. We support preemption and reservations. Elastic jobs recover from failure without losing progress. You will own real parts of the scheduling stack, and the opportunity to ship code into our open-source and internal platform code, and see the result in GPU-hours returned to researchers within days. The researchers training NVIDIA's own models are your users, and they will tell you quickly what works.

What You'll Be Doing

Design and build scheduling for large GPU fleets on both Slurm and Kubernetes. That covers queueing, gang and topology-aware placement on rack-scale NVLink systems, preemption, reservations and backfill that reaches the end of very deep queues.
Build the policy layer: fair share, quotas and allocations across many research teams, driven from a central allocation system and enforced the same way on every scheduler.
Run Slurm as a cloud-native service on Kubernetes, and extend Kubernetes batch scheduling (Kueue and its ecosystem) for training, reinforcement learning, sandboxes and inference.

Experience with workflow orchestrators such as Flyte, Airflow, Ray or Kubeflow at scale.

About The Role

Uber Marketplace is at the heart of Uber’s business, with Rider Pricing playing a critical role by setting prices and targeting promotions for Uber riders. Our team’s mission is to drive revenue growth, ridership growth and Uber’s profitability through advanced machine learning and data science. We build reliable, scalable platforms that optimize rider pricing in both real-time and offline systems, including baseline trip pricing and targeted discounts.

The Rider Pricing team is a fast-moving, high-opportunity space where you’ll have the chance to make a significant impact on the business. On this team, your work will affect over 95% of Uber’s mobility business revenue. You’ll take ownership of one key pillar of the rider pricing domain and lead the technical direction for improving our pricing algorithms, optimization algorithms and models. You will work across ML, serving, and optimization system components, and set technical direction for modeling best practices across model building, evaluation and deployment.

In this role, you'll apply advanced machine learning technologies, including deep learning, generative AI for causal modeling, representation learning and personalization, to optimize Uber’s pricing. You will also work with serving infrastructure and product teams to design and evolve the rider pricing systems to support new product and algorithm evolutions and drive Uber’s top-line rider and revenue growth.

What You’ll Do

Lead a group of SWEs and MLEs working on Uber’s rider pricing to develop and implement new machine learning and optimization techniques powering billions of rides around the world, and helping riders achieve their mobility needs.
Improve the performance of models and algorithms powering pricing algorithms and promotion targeting.
Own the problem E2E, including working with cross-functional teams to define the product and/or technical roadmap.
Mentor more junior team members by role modeling ML best practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and drive Uber’s ridership and revenue growth. Help Uber’s end-users by making mobility options accessible and affordable.

Basic Qualifications

Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, with 7+ years of full-time engineering experience.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., C, C++, Java, Python, Go).
Experience with machine learning and optimization algorithms.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, with 2+ years of full-time engineering experience.
Experience solving complex business problems by translating them into machine learning and optimization solutions.
Familiarity with large-scale data systems (e.g., Spark, Hive) and experience building production-ready algorithmic systems.
Strong background in deep learning, generative AI, causal modeling, and reinforcement learning.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer 4 - Finance Tech
new_jobs.description:
Do you love building and pioneering in the AI and technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Machine Learning Engineers
who are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge open source frameworks, advanced algorithms, and emerging technologies to join our team. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major AI transformations and scaling production models across Capital One.

Finance Tech is responsible for transforming Capital One's financial engine into the most trusted, nimble, and insightful in the industry. Our core mission is to engineer outcomes that strategically enable the Finance organization and the broader Enterprise to remain efficient. This mission is driven by four technical and functional pillars: Forecasting & Resiliency, providing advanced decision support; Treasury & Trade managing sophisticated cash and investment lifecycles; and Accounting & Reporting, ensuring the integrity of our general ledger and regulatory commitments. Powering these pillars are our Data and Core capabilities, which manage the orchestration, sourcing, and pipelines for critical financial data products.

By defining the next generation of financial technology, we ensure that every business process is backed by high fidelity tracking and reporting. Together, we are not just supporting the bottom line - we are building a strategic enabler that operates as a world class financial engine.

What You’ll Do:

The MLE role overlaps with many disciplines, such as Ops, Modeling, and Data Engineering. In this role, you'll be expected to perform many ML engineering activities, including one or more of the following:
Design, build, and/or deliver ML models and components that solve real-world business problems, while working in collaboration with the Product and Data Science teams
Inform your ML infrastructure decisions using your understanding of ML modeling techniques and issues, including choice of model, data, and feature selection, model training, hyperparameter tuning, dimensionality, bias/variance, and validation)
Solve complex problems by writing and testing application code, developing and validating ML models, and automating tests and deployment
Collaborate as part of a cross-functional Agile team to create and enhance software that enables state-of-the-art big data and ML applications
Retrain, maintain, and monitor models in production
Leverage or build cloud-based architectures, technologies, and/or platforms to deliver optimized ML models at scale
Construct optimized data pipelines to feed ML models
Leverage continuous integration and continuous deployment best practices, including test automation and monitoring, to ensure successful deployment of ML models and application code
Ensure all code is well-managed to reduce vulnerabilities, models are well-governed from a risk perspective, and the ML follows best practices in Responsible and Explainable AI
Use programming languages like Python, Scala, or Java

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Java, Golang, or C++
At least 4 years of Machine Learning experience using industry standard frameworks PyTorch or Tensorflow and libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
At least 4 years of experience using and operating large scale distributed systems (Spark, Ray) to prepare AI or Machine Learning data
At least 2 years of experience deploying and operating Machine Learning solutions in production and operating production services in the cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and using Kubernetes to manage large scale containerized Machine Learning software systems

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's or Doctoral Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related field
3+ years of experience optimizing ML algorithms, configurations, and infrastructure
3+ years of experience following software development best practices including source control, testing, code reviews, CI/CD, etc.
3+ years of experience building resilient software solutions with pre-production testing, advanced deployment techniques (one-box, blue/green, gradual dial-up), monitoring, alarms, and preparing incident response plans.
3+ years of experience working with Machine Learning techniques (Supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised, reinforcement learning, etc.) model types (Regression, Classification, Clustering, etc.), model Architectures (RNNs, CNNs, LSTMs, Transformers), training concepts (loss function, hyperparameters, regularization), and how to evaluate model accuracy and diagnose and address common issues (underfitting, overfitting)
3+ years of experience designing, implementing, and scaling production-ready data pipelines for training and evaluating ML models.
1+ years of experience as a technical lead developing ML solutions using industry best practices, patterns, and automation
Authored/co-authored a paper on a ML technique, model, or proof of concept

or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer
).

new_jobs.title: Machine Learning, Recommendation Systems (Ads Infra and Ranking)
new_jobs.description:
Meta's Ads organization builds the systems that help businesses of every size reach the people most likely to care about what they offer. At our core, we're builders who care about shipping real value. Within Ads, the Infra and Ranking organization owns the technical foundation that makes this work at Meta's scale: the ranking models that decide which ad is right for each moment; the retrieval and serving platforms that evaluate enormous candidate sets in milliseconds; and the underlying data, training, and inference infrastructure. All of this is done while maximizing compute efficiency, ensuring reliability and privacy, and using AI to speed up development.Our state-of-the-art research in deep learning architectures, sequence and representation learning, and generative recommenders continuously pushes the boundaries of personalization accuracy. Our innovations in distributed GPU training, model/system co-design, and large-scale low-latency serving let us deploy multi-billion-parameter models that learn continuously from real-time behavior — under strict efficiency, reliability, and privacy constraints.These advances in large-scale ML optimization, ads ranking quality, and personalization infrastructure are crucial to our revenue goals and to innovation across the Meta family of apps.As an ML Software Engineer in Ads Infra and Ranking, you will build production recommendation systems that improve ad relevance through retrieval and ranking. You will own model and software improvements from design and evaluation through rollout, partnering with data and serving engineers to deliver reliable personalization capabilities and measurable improvements.

Machine Learning, Recommendation Systems (Ads Infra and Ranking) Responsibilities:

Own a significant area of the ads ranking stack end to end — model architecture, features, training data, evaluation, and production rollout.
Lead architecture work in deep learning for recommendations (sequence models, multi-task and multi-objective learning, transfer learning, generative recommenders).
Define evaluation methodology and guardrails — offline/online correlation, calibration, holdouts, long-term and incrementality effects.
Drive value-model and auction-adjacent modeling work in partnership with auction, bidding, and pacing teams.
Lead GPU-scale training and serving efficiency work, including model/system co-design and inference optimization.
Set technical direction for a team, drive consensus, and lead successful cross-functional partnerships.
Raise engineering and modeling quality through code and design review, testing, staged rollouts, and monitoring.
Own reliability and responsible-AI practices for a major ranking surface.
Contribute to team and organizational growth through mentoring engineers, participating in recruiting and interviews, and identifying opportunities to improve team workflows.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
6+ years of programming experience in a relevant programming language OR 3+ years of experience + PhD
1+ years of hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: machine learning, recommendation systems, llms or artificial intelligence
Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Javascript or Hack
Experience with developing machine learning models at scale from inception to business impact
Knowledge developing and debugging in C/C++ and Java, or experience with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, PHP, and/or shell scripts
Track record of setting technical direction for a team, driving consensus and successful cross-functional partnerships
Proven experience designing, building, or deploying recommendation systems (e.g., collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches, personalization at scale)
Experience building and shipping high quality work and achieving high reliability
Experience improving quality through thoughtful code reviews, appropriate testing, proper rollout, monitoring, and proactive changes

Preferred Qualifications:

Direct experience with ads ranking or monetization — auction dynamics, bidding, pacing, value modeling, or advertiser-facing optimization
Experience with distributed training and large-scale low-latency model serving
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or another ML-related field
Experience with sequence modeling, multi-task/multi-objective optimization, and transfer learning for recommendations
Experience with GPU scaling, model/system co-design, CUDA, Triton, or inference optimization
Publications in top-tier conferences/journals, patents, or open-source contributions in the recommendations or LLM space
Experience with privacy-preserving or aggregated measurement and delayed-conversion modeling

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

new_jobs.title: Lead Agentic AI Solutions Engineer
new_jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

CVS Health is hiring a Lead Agentic AI Solutions Engineer to join the AI/ML Solutions Delivery organization and build enterprise-scale agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions. The Lead Agentic AI Solutions Engineer will serve as a full-stack AI engineer, designing, developing, and deploying production-ready applications that combine modern software engineering practices with generative AI and agentic frameworks. This role will lead the engineering and operationalization of enterprise-scale Agentic AI solutions supporting IT Operations, Cybersecurity, and intelligent automation use cases. The individual will architect, develop, and deploy end-to-end production agentic systems leveraging multi-agent architectures, prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), GraphRAG, memory frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and AI guardrails. This role will leverage technologies including ServiceNow, Databricks, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, Anthropic Claude, Python, APIs, and cloud-native services to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient solutions.

The Lead Agentic AI Solutions Engineer will own the end-to-end development lifecycle, spanning application architecture, backend services, AI orchestration, data integration, deployment, and operational support.

In addition to hands-on engineering responsibilities, this role will serve as a technical leader for assigned initiatives, providing architectural guidance, mentoring junior engineers, interns, and contractors, and helping establish engineering standards and best practices for enterprise AI delivery. Working closely with Architecture, Cybersecurity, Platform Engineering, Product, and Operations teams, this individual will help accelerate enterprise AI adoption while ensuring solutions meet CVS Health standards for security, governance, performance, reliability, and responsible AI practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy production-grade agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions using enterprise platforms including ServiceNow, Databricks, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, and Anthropic Claude.
Deliver AI-powered capabilities supporting IT Operations and Cybersecurity use cases such as incident triage, alert correlation, workflow orchestration, operational decision support, and intelligent remediation.
Design and implement end-to-end agentic AI systems utilizing multi-agent architectures, prompt engineering, context engineering, tool orchestration, memory frameworks, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks.
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector search, document ingestion, and enterprise knowledge integration solutions to improve AI accuracy and decision-making.
Lead the full solution lifecycle from architecture and prototyping through production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement while making informed technical tradeoff decisions.

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

THE ROLE

AMD is looking for a research engineer with practical implementation experience to advance AI-based medical imaging at the intersection of clinical imaging, deep learning, and high-performance computing on AMD platforms.

You will work across the full medical imaging workflow, from data preparation and preprocessing through model inference, post-processing, and evaluation, investigating modern pipelines and optimizing their design and implementation on AMD platforms. You will build reference designs, GPU kernels, and agentic frameworks that let these pipelines run at maximum performance on AMD devices such as the Ryzen AI Max+ and Radeon AI Pro, with hardware–model co-design as a central theme: tailoring model architecture to the properties of the underlying hardware so that computation maps efficiently onto the device. Areas of interest include image reconstruction, segmentation, detection, classification, tracking, and quality assessment across modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, and X-ray.

Working with AMD engineering and research teams, industry partners, and clinical collaborators, you will take imaging pipelines from problem definition through implementation, optimization, and evaluation; document your methods and results; and feed what you learn back to the libraries and kernel teams. Your findings will help establish the design frameworks and best practices for customers migrating imaging pipelines to AMD devices, and over time steer the team’s roadmap toward the co-design of next-generation imaging models: architected from the outset around AMD hardware for better mapping and efficiency.

THE PERSON

You bring a strong understanding of AI-based medical imaging and the programming skills to turn imaging models and algorithms into efficient software on AMD hardware. You have demonstrated experience writing code, profiling and tuning performance, and solving difficult technical problems. You can distinguish improvements that matter to a clinical imaging workflow running on device from gains in an isolated benchmark and communicate your findings clearly to both domain experts and systems engineers.

We value depth in one or more relevant areas, curiosity across the clinical, algorithmic, and systems disciplines, and the ability to take ownership of a technical project from investigation to validated results.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze modern AI-based medical imaging pipelines, understanding their clinical objectives, algorithms, computational requirements, and practical limitations.
Collaborate with research and industry partners to design and build new AI models for medical imaging.
Build or modify components of medical imaging pipelines across modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, and X-ray.
Prepare, preprocess, and validate imaging data in coordination with the team’s data-handling and privacy procedures.
Integrate and evaluate AI models for tasks such as reconstruction, segmentation, detection, classification, and tracking.
Measure and profile model and pipeline performance against agreed metrics such as latency, throughput, occupancy, and memory use.
Develop agentic frameworks that let domain experts target AMD devices more efficiently at the algorithm and graph-design level.
Develop prototypes, scripts, tests, and technical documentation.
Present findings and recommendations to internal teams, collaborators, and partners.

Required Experience

Strong programming skills in Python and experience with C++ or another language used for high-performance computing.
Hands-on experience implementing machine learning or deep learning models for imaging applications.
Experience with agentic design flows and AI coding tools such as Claude.
Solid understanding of image processing and common medical imaging concepts.
Experience profiling, debugging, and improving computational software.
Ability to make progress independently while on a defined technical problem and collaborate effectively across medical and engineering disciplines.
Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

Medical imaging modalities such as ultrasound, CT, MRI, or X-ray, in depth.
Imaging libraries and formats such as SimpleITK, ITK, MONAI, OpenCV, DICOM, and NIfTI.
Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, including custom operators or distributed training and inference.
Inference deployment and optimization with ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, ROCm, MIGraphX, HIP, CUDA, Triton, or comparable stacks.
Real-time, embedded, or GPU-accelerated pipelines.
GPU profiling and tuning of AI models to target GPU hardware more effectively.
Clinical or regulated data workflows, demonstrated through research, coursework, or projects.

Master’s or PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Medical Physics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

Join the elite technical and product engine of the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG). We are not a traditional project delivery organization; we are a practice of innovators and builders guiding our clients through the most significant shift in technology: the move to Agentic AI and Product-Led Operating Models. As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Agentic AI Delivery Engineer, you are a new breed of technologist—a "product-minded engineer" who is as fluent in the language of code as you are in the language of customer outcomes. You don't just build solutions; you leverage the best of technologies Google Cloud has to offer for client requirements, helping clients break free from legacy solution mindset and practices to build truly modern, value-driven software products on Google Cloud.

You Are:

A passionate, hands-on GCP specialist/practitioner who understands that great software is not just about elegant code, but about solving real problems leveraging the best technology tools available for a client. You are as comfortable building a multi-agent workflow on Vertex AI as you are testing a solution built by other team members in a compressed timeline, leveraging the various tools and technologies of Google Cloud. You have a consultative mindset and a deep curiosity to understand the "why" behind a client's business requirements and convert them to an optimal technology solution. You are an evangelist for modern ways of working, grounded in the principles of Product-Led engineering and operating models and related approaches. You are an exceptional communicator, great team player, continuous learner and a true believer in continual change.

The Work:

As a GCP Agentic AI Delivery Engineer, you will be a technical and product-centric engineer in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud Agentic solutions for client requirements. You will partner with Accenture's global delivery teams by providing superior technical expertise and product innovation skills. Your role is to execute complex technology solutions for our clients by designing, building, and demonstrating Agentic AI solutions. You will act as a trusted team player, guiding others in the team on how to adopt a Product Engineering mindset and be the expert on specific Google Cloud technologies/products.

Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. Design, build, test and deploy innovative, agentic-first solutions on GCP that are directly tied to the client business requirements.

Hands-On Development & Proof-of-Value: Rapidly design, build, and present compelling proof-of-concept (POC) solutions that bring your Google Cloud proficiency to workable solutions. This includes hands-on software engineering using Vertex AI, Gemini/Agentic AI, BigQuery, Google Data technologies, Terraform, and modern CI/CD practices.

Product-Led Project delivery: Act as an agile SME/coach on modern software development. Guide and enable the delivery team on the principles of the Product Agile Operating Model and how to structure delivery sprints for continuous delivery using Google Cloud Technologies.

Team Collaboration: Ability to travel as needed for project meetings, workshops, client discussions, etc., Working with global teams and leveraging the various collaborative tools and channels for project delivery and status reporting.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).

Minimum of 3 years of experience in a hands-on, client-facing technology role (e.g., Google Cloud Engineer, Product Engineer, Technology Consultant).

Minimum of 3 years of deep, hands-on experience architecting and building solutions on GCP.

Minimum of 2 years of experience interacting with project team members distributed across the globe. Well versed in project management methodologies and product/project testing methodologies.

Minimum of 2 years of proven experience on Google Cloud technologies OR Minimum of 1 years of implementation experience on EITHER Agentic systems, leveraging Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Azure Foundry, Microsoft Co-Pilot and/or AWS Bedrock OR on Agentic systems and Google Gemini Enterprise Partner Specialist certifications (CPS)

Bonus points if you have

Product & Agile Mindset: Hands-on experience working within a Product Operating Model. Practical experience in delivering agile projects, contributing to sprint-based deliverables and outcomes.

Consulting & Innovation Acumen: Experience participating in client-facing innovation workshops and converting ideas into outcome-focused solutions. World-class communication skills to articulate project status and delivery challenges and issues to project leadership and client audiences.

Agentic AI & Software Product Engineering: Proven experience architecting and building agentic workflows using Vertex AI. Deep understanding of agentic components, including reasoning engines, planning, tool use, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Hands-on expertise with Google's Gemini models. A commitment to software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and building secure, scalable products.

Technical Depth: Google Cloud Professional certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Data Engineer, GenAI Leader). Project experience across the GCP ecosystem, including GKE, BigQuery, Vertex AI, CES, Apigee, and other GCP technologies.

Experience working with Graph Databases, graph query language, and related algorithms

new_jobs.title: Life Sciences AI Research Engineer
new_jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

THE ROLE

AMD is looking for a hands-on research engineer to advance life sciences computing at the intersection of computational biology, AI, and high-performance computing.

You will investigate emerging scientific workloads, develop and optimize algorithms, and build software that enables researchers to tackle larger and more complex biological problems on AMD platforms. Areas of interest include genomics, biological foundation models, protein and molecular modeling, and computational drug discovery.

Working with AMD researchers, software engineers, and external collaborators, you will take projects from scientific problem definition through implementation and evaluation. Your findings will help identify where AMD can deliver meaningful advances in life sciences computing and guide future research and software investments.

THE PERSON

You bring deep understanding of a computational life sciences domain and the programming skills to turn scientific ideas into working software. You enjoy writing code, testing hypotheses, and solving difficult technical problems. You can distinguish improvements that matter to a scientific workflow from gains in an isolated benchmark and communicate your findings clearly to both domain scientists and systems engineers.

We value depth in one or more relevant areas, curiosity across disciplines, and the ability to take ownership of a technical project from investigation to validated results.

Key Responsibilities

Investigate important and emerging life sciences workloads, understanding their scientific objectives, algorithms, computational requirements, and practical limitations.
Develop, implement, and evaluate algorithms and AI methods for applications in genomics, biomolecular modeling, or related areas.
Profile and optimize scientific applications and AI workflows on AMD platforms, addressing bottlenecks in computation, memory, data processing, and communication.
Explore algorithmic reformulations, parallelization strategies, numerical precision, and GPU acceleration while preserving scientific validity.
Build reproducible benchmarks that measure end-to-end performance, scalability, resource use, and relevant scientific outcomes.
Work directly with academic and industry collaborators to translate scientific needs into technical requirements and working implementations.
Contribute reusable software, optimized operators, and improvements to relevant open-source projects.
Translate experimental findings into recommendations for AMD’s research priorities, software capabilities, and hardware requirements.
Communicate results through technical reports, demonstrations, publications, and invention disclosures, as appropriate.

Required Experience

Strong computational expertise in at least one life sciences area, such as computational genomics, bioinformatics, protein modeling, computational chemistry, or molecular simulation.
Hands-on experience implementing scientific algorithms or developing machine learning models for biological applications.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with C++ or another language used for high-performance scientific computing.
Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, numerical methods, and experimental evaluation.
Experience profiling, debugging, and improving computational software.
Ability to work independently on a defined technical problem and collaborate effectively across scientific and engineering disciplines.
Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

Biological foundation models, protein structure prediction or design, molecular generative models, or genomic sequence modeling.
Scientific AI architectures, including transformers, geometric deep learning, graph neural networks, or diffusion models.
GPU programming and optimization using HIP, CUDA, Triton, or comparable technologies.
Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, including custom operators or distributed training and inference.
Parallel algorithms, multi-GPU computing, or large-scale scientific workflows.
Established life sciences software ecosystems and experience extending or contributing to open-source tools.
Research contributions demonstrated through publications, software, patents, or deployed scientific applications.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

Master’s, or PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Chemistry, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

LOCATION:
Longmont, CO; Austin, TX and Santa Clara, Ca are options.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
