new_jobs.title: MarTech Multi-Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the connective tissue across our clients' marketing and advertising technology ecosystems, spanning customer data platforms, journey orchestration and decisioning, campaign and content platforms, and adjacent AdTech capabilities, all increasingly powered by AI and agentic technologies. You will move fluidly across platforms and vendors rather than anchoring to a single stack, advising clients on the art of the possible, designing composable, future-ready architectures, and leading implementation across MarTech, AdTech, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role suits a technologist who treats the pace of change in this space as the appealing part of the job: someone who stays current on emerging platforms and AI capabilities, pilots new tools ahead of the market, and brings that point of view to clients and internal teams alike.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 13, 2027

Work you'll do

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

Architecting end-to-end solutions across the marketing technology landscape (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform/AEP, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Target; Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce; and comparable platforms) to enable unified customer profiles, journey orchestration, and omnichannel personalization

Bridging MarTech and AdTech ecosystems by integrating CDPs with ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, identity resolution, and measurement/attribution platforms to enable addressable, privacy-safe advertising and cross-channel activation

Architecting and maintaining identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph solutions, including identity matching logic, resolution accuracy, and data collection strategies that feed a unified, enterprise-wide view of the customer

Embedding AI and agentic capabilities into client marketing and advertising ecosystems, including generative content and personalization, AI assistants/copilots, and next-best-action or agent orchestration, and continuously evaluating emerging tools as the landscape evolves

Advising clients on future-state architecture design, feasibility, level of effort, cost, and the art of the possible, across composable, API-first MarTech and AdTech stacks

Leading technical pre-sales and solutioning (hunter/farmer cycles), translating business and marketing goals into technical designs, estimates, and phased implementation roadmaps

Leading integration and solution delivery across multiple platforms, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during technical design and implementation

Building and leading high-performing, cross-functional, geographically distributed teams of architects, engineers, and analysts, and establishing reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks

Evaluating and recommending composable architecture approaches that enable clients to assemble modular, best-of-breed MarTech/AdTech capabilities rather than defaulting to a single monolithic platform

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Genuine curiosity and a pioneer's mindset: energized, not unsettled, by a marketing and advertising technology landscape that is constantly introducing new platforms, tools, and AI capabilities

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of hands-on experience across marketing technology and/or advertising technology platforms, including implementation experience with at least two major MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud/Data Cloud, mParticle, Segment, Tealium, or comparable)
7+ years of experience architecting Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions, including data modeling, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and activation
7+ years of experience with identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph technologies or platforms (e.g., Acxiom, LiveRamp, or similar), including identity matching logic and resolution accuracy
5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales or solution architecture engagements, including level-of-effort, cost estimation, and roadmap development
5+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting MarTech/AdTech workloads
2+ years of experience with AI/agentic capabilities embedded in MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., AI assistants/copilots, generative personalization, agent orchestration)
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience with composable architecture / MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) principles
Working knowledge of the AdTech ecosystem, including ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, programmatic buying, identity/addressability solutions, and measurement and attribution
Adobe Certified Expert/Professional and/or Salesforce certifications spanning CDP, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce
Experience integrating MarTech platforms with AdTech data, identity, or clean-room solutions (e.g., LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, Google Marketing Platform)
Experience collaborating with identity partners to evolve identity graph coverage and improve enterprise-wide customer data mapping and digital tracking accuracy
A demonstrated track record as an early adopter, piloting new platforms, tools, or AI capabilities ahead of broad market adoption and driving their adoption within teams or client organizations
Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
Programming or scripting experience in Python, SQL, or Java
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related technical field

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 - $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect – Application, Cloud & Digital Transformation
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

As a Solution Architect – Application Modernization, Cloud & Digital Transformation, you will make an impact by leading solution architecture for large, complex client pursuits and transformation opportunities. You will translate client business objectives, technology priorities, and challenges into differentiated, scalable, and commercially viable solutions across application services, modernization, cloud, and digital transformation. You will work collaboratively with sales, delivery, technology, practice, and commercial teams to develop compelling solutions that deliver measurable business and technology outcomes.

In This Role, You Will

Lead end-to-end solution architecture for large and complex pursuits, proactive proposals, and RFP/RFI responses across Application Maintenance, Application Development, Modernization, Cloud, and Digital Transformation programs.

Translate client business objectives, IT priorities, pain points, and requirements into compelling solution themes, win strategies, and differentiated solutions that are technically feasible and commercially viable.

Design scalable, secure, resilient, and future-ready solutions across AMS, ADM, application modernization, cloud transformation, DevSecOps, SRE, AIOps, technical debt management, and AI/GenAI-enabled engineering.

Define comprehensive solution and operating models covering architecture, delivery approach, transformation roadmap, governance, resource models, tooling, automation, transition, risks, assumptions, and dependencies.

Identify opportunities to drive productivity, quality, speed, and cost efficiency through automation, AI/GenAI, accelerators, platforms, reusable assets, and industry best practices.

Collaborate with sales, delivery, practice, technology, and commercial teams to ensure proposed solutions are executable, differentiated, aligned with client expectations, and supportive of commercial objectives.

Lead solution presentations and discussions with client and executive stakeholders, clearly articulating architecture decisions, business value, differentiators, transformation outcomes, risks, and trade-offs.

Adapt solution architecture and delivery approaches as client priorities, requirements, technology landscapes, and business needs evolve.

Work model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring three days a week in a client or Cognizant office. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

15+ years of experience in IT services, technology consulting, solution architecture, or related areas, including significant experience designing solutions for complex client business and technology requirements.

7+ years of experience leading solution architecture or solutioning activities for large, complex pursuits, proposals, RFPs/RFIs, and transformation opportunities.

Proven experience leading large, multi-service-line proposals and managing solution activities across sales, delivery, technology, practice, and commercial stakeholders.

Deep understanding of digital services and enterprise technology solutions, with experience across application maintenance and development, application modernization, cloud transformation, DevSecOps, SRE, AIOps, automation, technical debt management, and AI/GenAI-enabled engineering.

Demonstrated experience developing solution architectures, delivery and operating models, transformation roadmaps, governance models, transition approaches, and associated risks, assumptions, and dependencies.

Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technology solutions, business value, differentiators, risks, and trade-offs.

Experience incorporating AI/GenAI, automation, accelerators, reusable assets, and platforms into enterprise transformation solutions.

These will help you stand out

TOGAF, ITIL, Agile, Cloud, AI, or other relevant architecture and technology certifications.

Experience developing differentiated solutions that balance technology innovation, delivery feasibility, business value, and commercial objectives.

Experience in solutioning for Retail, consumer goods and Manufacturing domains.

Bachelors/Master’s degree in a technology-related discipline, MBA, or equivalent advanced education or professional experience.

Applications will be accepted till October 23rd, 2026.

Salary And Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $119,700 to $180,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Stock Purchase Plan

new_jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect (Process and Intelligence Automation)
new_jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

U.S. Bank is seeking an experienced Enterprise Technology Architect to define, lead, and evolve our enterprise-wide Technology architecture strategy. As a member of the Enterprise Architecture team, this role closely partners with the business and the other members of the technology organization to design modern, resilient, and secure technology ecosystems and platforms that align with business objectives. The ideal candidate will have a blend of strategic and technical thinking, solving the most complex enterprise technology problems with enterprise grade solutions.

Responsibilities

Define and evolve the enterprise technology architecture strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, technology roadmaps, and modernization initiatives.
Establish and drive enterprise architecture practices, standards, and reference architectures across federated architecture and engineering teams.
Leverage Enterprise Architecture platforms (e.g., LeanIX, Ardoq) to maintain architecture visibility, governance, and decision-making processes.
Design and govern enterprise-wide technology ecosystems, integration patterns, and platform strategies across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.
Lead the architecture of scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing technology solutions that support enterprise growth and operational excellence.
Define and enforce technology governance, architecture review processes, compliance controls, security standards, and quality frameworks.
Partner with business, product, engineering, data, security, and infrastructure leaders to translate strategic priorities into executable technology architectures.
Provide technical leadership throughout the product and solution lifecycle, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring adherence to enterprise standards and best practices.
Experience within Banking, Financial Services, Payments, or Wealth Management environments preferred.
Cloud architecture experience with Azure, AWS, hybrid cloud, and enterprise platform modernization initiatives preferred.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
Eight or more years of relevant experience

Skills & Qualifications

Deep expertise in Enterprise Architecture, technology strategy, and large-scale enterprise solution design within complex organizations.
Hands-on experience with Enterprise Architecture tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq, or equivalent architecture repositories and modeling platforms.
Strong expertise in Data Modeling, Data Engineering, Databricks, Data Pipelines, ETL/ELT Processes, and Analytics Platforms.
Strong knowledge of architecture frameworks including TOGAF, ITIL, COBIT, Zachman, and modeling approaches such as ArchiMate, UML, and C4.
Proven ability to design modern application, platform, infrastructure, and integration architectures across hybrid environments.
Experience implementing technology governance, risk management, privacy, security, and compliance controls within enterprise environments.
Hands-on experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, including Claude Code, Generative AI, LLMs, and modern programming languages.
Strong background in software engineering and solution delivery, including prior experience as a senior engineer or technical lead.
Expertise designing resilient, scalable, highly available application and infrastructure platforms, including cloud-native and distributed architectures.
Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence executive and technical audiences.

Location Expectations

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
Basic term and optional term life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability
Pregnancy disability and parental leave
401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan
Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
Adoption assistance
Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

If you already have a profile with us, you can log in to check status.

Need Help?

Regular or Temporary:

Regular

Language Fluency:
English (Required)

Work Shift:

1st shift (United States of America)

Please review the following job description:

Designs, develops, and implements BI, analytics, and AI capabilities and data-driven solutions, and leads large technical initiatives to address complex business challenges. This role supports enterprise business intelligence, analytics, and reporting initiatives within the banking and financial services industry.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions, along with a solid understanding of cloud technologies, data architecture, and data engineering concepts. The candidate can implement AI on BI and feature store capabilities, understand end-to-end data flows across cloud-based data pipelines, and translate complex business requirements into meaningful analytical insights. Experience supporting banking technology organizations, particularly CIO or executive-level reporting functions, is highly preferred.

This position is office-based, onsite 5 days/week.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

new_jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Generative AI - Risk Tech)
new_jobs.description:
Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Full-stack Software Engineers who are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge open source frameworks and emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One.

In Risk Tech, we provide the foundation for Capital One to thrive in an uncertain world. Our engaged, empowered, and intelligent people produce outstanding products, working toward the common goal of transforming risk management with technology. We build data-driven tools that use machine learning to prevent risks & automatically detect issues before they impact our customers, our business, or our communities.

In this role at Risk Tech, you will work with our GRC team and partners across the company to build and deploy proprietary solutions for Risk management that are powered by state-of-the-art AI technology. Our products, enhanced with the transformative power of AI, are central to our business and deliver tremendous customer value.

What You’ll Do:

Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company
Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal & external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community
Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment
Utilize programming languages like Java, Scala, Python, Go, Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, Open Source RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of AWS tools and services
Provide technical leadership and direction across Agile teams, setting standards for design, development, and operational excellence
Partner with architects to define service boundaries, integration patterns, and reusable frameworks
Proactively identify areas for improvement, implementing targeted refactoring and contributing to efforts that reduce technical debt and enhance system performance
Influence long-term technology strategy through evaluation of emerging tools and practices in a ‘you build it, you own it’ environment

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
At least 4 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply)
At least 2 years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
7+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C#, Scala
3+ years of experience with database and database management systems
3+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or cloud-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies
4+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks
3+ years of experience with front-end JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks
4+ years of experience creating synchronous and asynchronous APIs
3+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks
3+ years of experience using Git-based version-control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Bitbucket)
3+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments
Experience leveraging modern AI-based coding tools and IDE copilots
1+ year of experience mentoring engineers and driving professional development within technical teams
1+ year of experience leveraging observability to identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in distributed systems
Experience with interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion
Experience leading cross-functional engineering efforts or large-scale technical initiatives
Experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams

Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $197,300 - $225,100 for Full-stack Engineer 4

Richmond, VA: $179,400 - $204,700 for Full-stack Engineer 4

new_jobs.title: MarTech Multi-Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the connective tissue across our clients' marketing and advertising technology ecosystems, spanning customer data platforms, journey orchestration and decisioning, campaign and content platforms, and adjacent AdTech capabilities, all increasingly powered by AI and agentic technologies. You will move fluidly across platforms and vendors rather than anchoring to a single stack, advising clients on the art of the possible, designing composable, future-ready architectures, and leading implementation across MarTech, AdTech, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role suits a technologist who treats the pace of change in this space as the appealing part of the job: someone who stays current on emerging platforms and AI capabilities, pilots new tools ahead of the market, and brings that point of view to clients and internal teams alike.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 13, 2027

Work you'll do

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

Architecting end-to-end solutions across the marketing technology landscape (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform/AEP, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Target; Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce; and comparable platforms) to enable unified customer profiles, journey orchestration, and omnichannel personalization

Bridging MarTech and AdTech ecosystems by integrating CDPs with ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, identity resolution, and measurement/attribution platforms to enable addressable, privacy-safe advertising and cross-channel activation

Architecting and maintaining identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph solutions, including identity matching logic, resolution accuracy, and data collection strategies that feed a unified, enterprise-wide view of the customer

Embedding AI and agentic capabilities into client marketing and advertising ecosystems, including generative content and personalization, AI assistants/copilots, and next-best-action or agent orchestration, and continuously evaluating emerging tools as the landscape evolves

Advising clients on future-state architecture design, feasibility, level of effort, cost, and the art of the possible, across composable, API-first MarTech and AdTech stacks

Leading technical pre-sales and solutioning (hunter/farmer cycles), translating business and marketing goals into technical designs, estimates, and phased implementation roadmaps

Leading integration and solution delivery across multiple platforms, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during technical design and implementation

Building and leading high-performing, cross-functional, geographically distributed teams of architects, engineers, and analysts, and establishing reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks

Evaluating and recommending composable architecture approaches that enable clients to assemble modular, best-of-breed MarTech/AdTech capabilities rather than defaulting to a single monolithic platform

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Genuine curiosity and a pioneer's mindset: energized, not unsettled, by a marketing and advertising technology landscape that is constantly introducing new platforms, tools, and AI capabilities

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of hands-on experience across marketing technology and/or advertising technology platforms, including implementation experience with at least two major MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud/Data Cloud, mParticle, Segment, Tealium, or comparable)
7+ years of experience architecting Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions, including data modeling, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and activation
7+ years of experience with identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph technologies or platforms (e.g., Acxiom, LiveRamp, or similar), including identity matching logic and resolution accuracy
5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales or solution architecture engagements, including level-of-effort, cost estimation, and roadmap development
5+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting MarTech/AdTech workloads
2+ years of experience with AI/agentic capabilities embedded in MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., AI assistants/copilots, generative personalization, agent orchestration)
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience with composable architecture / MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) principles
Working knowledge of the AdTech ecosystem, including ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, programmatic buying, identity/addressability solutions, and measurement and attribution
Adobe Certified Expert/Professional and/or Salesforce certifications spanning CDP, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce
Experience integrating MarTech platforms with AdTech data, identity, or clean-room solutions (e.g., LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, Google Marketing Platform)
Experience collaborating with identity partners to evolve identity graph coverage and improve enterprise-wide customer data mapping and digital tracking accuracy
A demonstrated track record as an early adopter, piloting new platforms, tools, or AI capabilities ahead of broad market adoption and driving their adoption within teams or client organizations
Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
Programming or scripting experience in Python, SQL, or Java
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related technical field

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 - $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
